title.zh: 卷323 列傳一百十 黄廷桂 鄂弥达 杨廷璋 庄有恭 李侍尧 李奉尧 伍弥泰 官保
title.en: Volume 323 Biographies 110: Huang Tinggui, E Mida, Yang Tingzhang, Zhuang Yougong, Li Shiyao, Li Fengyao, Wu Mitai, Guan Bao
title.raw: 卷323 列傳一百十 黄廷桂 鄂弥达 杨廷璋 庄有恭 李侍尧 李奉尧 伍弥泰 官保

sentences.zh: =黃廷桂=黃廷桂，字丹崖，漢軍鑲紅旗人。

translations.literal: Huang Tinggui, style name Danya, was a Han military bannerman of the Bordered Red Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Tinggui, whose style was Danya, belonged to the Han military contingent of the Bordered Red Banner.

sentences.zh: 父秉中，官福建巡撫。

translations.literal: His father Bingzhong served as Fujian provincial governor.
translations.idiomatic: His father Bingzhong had been Fujian provincial governor.

sentences.zh: 廷桂，初襲曾祖憲章拖沙喇哈番世職。

translations.literal: Tinggui at first inherited from his great-grandfather Xianzhang the hereditary rank of tošanlahafan.
translations.idiomatic: Tinggui first succeeded to the hereditary tošanlahafan rank held by his great-grandfather Xianzhang.

sentences.zh: 康熙五十二年，授三等侍衛，遷參領。

translations.literal: In the fifty-second year of Kangxi he was appointed a third-class bodyguard and later promoted to company commander.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 52 he received appointment as a third-class imperial guardsman and was later made a company commander.

sentences.zh: 聖祖幸熱河，屢扈從。

translations.literal: When the Sacred Ancestor visited Rehe, he repeatedly accompanied him on the journey.
translations.idiomatic: He often attended the Kangxi emperor on his visits to Rehe.

sentences.zh: 世宗在潛邸，知其才，雍正三年，授直隸宣化總兵。

translations.literal: While the future Yongzheng Emperor was still in his princely residence he recognized Tinggui's ability; in the third year of Yongzheng he was appointed general of Xuanhua in Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: The future Yongzheng emperor had already noted his talent while still heir apparent; in Yongzheng 3 he was made Xuanhua regional commander in Zhili.

sentences.zh: 五年，擢四川提督。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was promoted to Sichuan provincial military commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was elevated to provincial military commander of Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「四川三面環夷。

translations.literal: In a memorial he stated: "Sichuan is surrounded on three sides by barbarian peoples.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized: "Sichuan is ringed on three sides by non-Han peoples.

sentences.zh: 軍械多敝缺，現飭修補。

translations.literal: Much of the military equipment is worn and deficient; orders have now been issued to repair it.
translations.idiomatic: Much of the ordnance is worn out; I have already ordered repairs.

sentences.zh: 川馬本不高大，又日系槽，多羸斃。

translations.literal: Sichuan horses are by nature not tall, and because they are daily kept in stalls many grow weak and die.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan horses are naturally small, and because they are stabled every day many become emaciated and perish.

sentences.zh: 令在豐樂場後荒山督牧。

translations.literal: He ordered them pastured under supervision on the barren hills behind Fengle Pasture.
translations.idiomatic: He has ordered them grazed under supervision on the wild hills behind Fengle Pasture.

sentences.zh: 士卒驕奢，飭服用毋僭官制。

translations.literal: The soldiers are arrogant and extravagant; he ordered that their dress must not transgress official regulations.
translations.idiomatic: The troops have grown arrogant and extravagant; he has ordered that their dress must not exceed official regulations.

sentences.zh: 歲十月，番入內地傭工，名曰'下壩'，次年夏初始歸，以禁攜婦女，致成群肆惡，飭攜家屬方許就僱。

translations.literal: Every year in the tenth month tribesmen enter the interior to hire out as laborers, called 'going down to the dam'; they do not return until early summer of the next year; because they were forbidden to bring women they formed gangs and committed outrages, so he ordered that only those who brought their families might be hired.
translations.idiomatic: Each year in the tenth month tribesmen come into the interior to work as hired labor in what is called 'going down to the dam,' and do not return until early the following summer; forbidding them to bring their wives had led them to band together and run riot, so he ruled that only men who brought their families might be employed.

sentences.zh: 成都屬德陽、仁壽二縣，南北距數百里，駐一把總；

translations.literal: Under Chengdu are the two counties of Deyang and Renshou, several hundred li apart north and south, yet only a platoon commander is stationed there;
translations.idiomatic: Chengdu prefecture includes Deyang and Renshou, hundreds of li apart north and south, yet only a platoon commander is posted there;

sentences.zh: 永寧協駐貴州永寧城，中隔河，東隸黔，西隸蜀，兵民歧視，應更定汛守。

translations.literal: The Yongning garrison command is stationed at Yongning city in Guizhou; a river runs between, with the east under Guizhou and the west under Sichuan, so troops and civilians regard each other with suspicion; the garrison posts ought to be redrawn.
translations.idiomatic: The Yongning brigade is stationed at Yongning in Guizhou, with a river between jurisdictions so that the east belongs to Guizhou and the west to Sichuan, breeding mutual distrust between soldiers and civilians; the garrison dispositions should be revised.

sentences.zh: 」命會總督岳鍾琪議行。

translations.literal: " He was ordered to consult with Governor-General Yue Zhongqi and carry out the plan.
translations.idiomatic: " The court ordered him to consult Governor-General Yue Zhongqi and implement the measures.

sentences.zh: 又奏請嚴捕竊賊及博奕之具，上諭曰：「禁令弗行，咎在不公不明，不在不嚴。

translations.literal: He also memorialized requesting strict arrest of thieves and gambling paraphernalia; the emperor instructed: "When prohibitions fail, the fault lies in unfairness and lack of clarity, not in insufficient severity.
translations.idiomatic: He also asked for vigorous arrests of thieves and seizure of gambling equipment; the emperor replied: "When a ban fails, the blame is unfair or unclear enforcement, not insufficient severity.

sentences.zh: 法猶藥也，取攻疾而已。

translations.literal: Law is like medicine: it is taken only to attack the disease.
translations.idiomatic: Law is like medicine—it is meant only to cure the ailment.

sentences.zh: 過峻厲則傷元氣，徒猛不足貴也。

translations.literal: If it is excessively harsh it injures the vital force; mere fierceness is not to be prized.
translations.idiomatic: Excessive harshness damages the body politic; brute force alone is nothing to admire.

sentences.zh: 」又奏嚴治建昌降番劫掠，又奏省城設防火堆棚，營置救火兵二十，上並嘉之。

translations.literal: " He also memorialized on strict punishment of Jianchang surrendered tribesmen who plundered, and on setting up fire-watch beacon sheds in the provincial capital and assigning twenty fire-fighting soldiers; the emperor commended both.
translations.idiomatic: " He also reported strict measures against looting by surrendered tribesmen in Jianchang, and proposed fire-watch sheds in the provincial capital with twenty fire-fighting troops; the emperor approved both.

sentences.zh: 六年，請於提標及城守等營各設義塾，上諭曰：「文武不可偏重。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he requested that charity schools be established in each camp of the provincial commander's standard and the city-garrison camps; the emperor instructed: "Civil and military pursuits must not be weighted one against the other.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he asked that charity schools be set up in the provincial commander's camp and the city-garrison camps; the emperor replied: "Civil and military training must not be lopsided.

sentences.zh: 少年聰穎，稍通文墨，勢必流為怯懦，不原為兵。

translations.literal: Youths who are clever and gain some knowledge of letters will inevitably become timid and unwilling to serve as soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Bright young men who pick up a little literacy will inevitably turn soft and refuse soldiering.

sentences.zh: 則營伍所餘，皆魯鈍一流。

translations.literal: Then what remains in the camps will all be the dull and obtuse sort.
translations.idiomatic: What is left in the ranks will be the slow and dull-witted.

sentences.zh: 是非興文，實乃廢武。

translations.literal: This is not promoting letters but in fact abolishing the military.
translations.idiomatic: That is not promoting literacy but effectively dismantling the army.

sentences.zh: 邀虛名而無實益，將焉用之？

translations.literal: It seeks empty reputation without real benefit—of what use is it?
translations.idiomatic: It courts empty praise with no real gain—what is the point?

sentences.zh: 烏蒙米貼苗婦陸氏為亂，發永寧、遵義兵援剿。

translations.literal: The Miao woman Lu of Mitie in Wumeng raised a rebellion; troops from Yongning and Zunyi were dispatched to assist in suppression.
translations.idiomatic: Lu, a Miao woman of Mitie in Wumeng, rebelled, and troops from Yongning and Zunyi were sent to help suppress her.

sentences.zh: 四川雷波土司楊明義陰助陸氏，誘附近結覺、阿路、阿照、平底諸苗劫糧。

translations.literal: Yang Mingyi, native chieftain of Leibo in Sichuan, secretly aided Lu and incited the nearby tribes of Jiejue, Alu, Azhao, and Pingdi to plunder grain supplies.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Mingyi, the Leibo native chieftain in Sichuan, secretly backed Lu and stirred up neighboring Jiejue, Alu, Azhao, and Pingdi tribesmen to raid grain convoys.

sentences.zh: 陸氏既擒，請剿明義，令廷桂率總兵張耀祖率兵往。

translations.literal: After Lu was captured, he requested a campaign against Mingyi and was ordered to lead Regional Commander Zhang Yaozu and the troops thither.
translations.idiomatic: Once Lu was taken, he asked to campaign against Mingyi and was told to lead Regional Commander Zhang Yaozu and the army there.

sentences.zh: 軍至拉密，擒明義，並獲造謀人卑租及結覺酋雙尺、阿路酋魯佩及阿不羅酋覺逼，斬馘近萬。

translations.literal: When the army reached Lami they captured Mingyi, together with the plotter Beizu and the chiefs Shuangchi of Jiejue, Lupei of Alu, and Juebi of Aboluo; nearly ten thousand heads were cut off.
translations.idiomatic: At Lami the army seized Mingyi along with the ringleader Beizu and chiefs Shuangchi of Jiejue, Lupei of Alu, and Juebi of Aboluo; nearly ten thousand heads were taken.

sentences.zh: 上諭曰：「覽奏，斬馘何啻獵人弋獸！

translations.literal: The emperor instructed: "Having read your memorial, the slaughter of heads is no different from a hunter shooting game!
translations.idiomatic: The emperor wrote back: "Your report reads as though you were hunting game—nearly ten thousand heads!

sentences.zh: 儻兵退仍復如故，豈有盡行殺戮之理？

translations.literal: If when the troops withdraw things return as before, is there any principle in killing everyone?
translations.idiomatic: If everything reverts once the army leaves, what sense is there in exterminating them all?

sentences.zh: 當詳思善於措置之道。

translations.literal: You ought to consider carefully how to handle matters well.
translations.idiomatic: Think hard about a lasting settlement.

sentences.zh: 」師復進攻確裡密、阿都、阿驢諸苗，砲殪確裡密酋利耶。

translations.literal: " The army again advanced against the tribes of Quelimi, Adu, and Alü; artillery killed Liye, chief of Quelimi.
translations.idiomatic: " The force pressed on against Quelimi, Adu, and Alü; cannon fire killed Liye, chief of Quelimi.

sentences.zh: 阿都苗擒其酋阿必以獻，阿驢苗降。

translations.literal: The Adu tribesmen captured their chief Abi and presented him; the Alü tribes submitted.
translations.idiomatic: The Adu people handed over their chief Abi; the Alü tribes surrendered.

sentences.zh: 七年，奏軍事竟，上以效忠奮勇嘉之。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he reported the military affairs concluded; the emperor commended his loyal service and bold exertion.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he reported the campaign finished; the emperor praised his loyalty and valor.

sentences.zh: 尋疏陳苗疆地方諸事，上命籌善後。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he memorialized in detail on various matters in the Miao frontier regions; the emperor ordered him to plan for post-campaign settlement.
translations.idiomatic: He soon submitted a detailed account of frontier affairs; the emperor told him to work out a lasting settlement.

sentences.zh: 復奏湖北容美土司田雯如在四川界徵花絲銀，諮湖北察究。

translations.literal: He again reported that Tian Wenru, native chieftain of Rongmei in Hubei, was levying flowered-silk silver within the Sichuan border, and asked Hubei to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: He also reported that Tian Wenru, the Rongmei chieftain in Hubei, was collecting "flowered-silk silver" inside the Sichuan border and asked Hubei to look into it.

sentences.zh: 上諭曰：「楚、蜀諸土司容美最富強，越分僭禮。

translations.literal: The emperor instructed: "Among the native chieftains of Chu and Shu, Rongmei is the wealthiest and strongest, overstepping its rank and usurping ritual privileges.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor replied: "Of the Hubei and Sichuan chieftains, Rongmei is the richest and most powerful, and has long overstepped its station.

sentences.zh: 應曉以大義，漸令革除。

translations.literal: They should be enlightened with the larger principle and gradually made to abolish such practices.
translations.idiomatic: Enlighten them with reason and phase such abuses out gradually.

sentences.zh: 」又奏籌剿瞻對土司，上諭曰：「瞻對雖微，亦不可輕視。

translations.literal: " He also memorialized on planning a campaign against the Drayap native chieftain; the emperor instructed: "Though Drayap is small, it must not be treated lightly.
translations.idiomatic: " He also outlined plans against the Drayap chieftain; the emperor warned: "Drayap may be small, but do not underestimate it.

sentences.zh: 凡事概以敬慎出之。

translations.literal: In all matters proceed from reverence and caution.
translations.idiomatic: Handle everything with respect and care.

sentences.zh: 」奏請開採黃螂等處銅鉛，以資鼓鑄。

translations.literal: " He memorialized requesting the opening of copper and lead mines at Huanglang and elsewhere to supply coinage.
translations.idiomatic: " He asked permission to mine copper and lead at Huanglang and elsewhere to feed the mints.

sentences.zh: 上諭曰：「黃螂、雷波與新撫涼山諸夷錯壤，第宜示以靜鎮，胡可興起利端？

translations.literal: The emperor instructed: "Huanglang, Leibo, and the Liangshan tribes newly brought under pacification have interlocking territories; one should only show calm restraint—how can profit-seeking be stirred up?
translations.idiomatic: The emperor objected: "Huanglang and Leibo border the newly pacified Liangshan tribes; the right policy is quiet restraint—why invite trouble for profit?

sentences.zh: 若聽民開採，流亡無藉之徒必群相趨赴，釀生事故。

translations.literal: If the people are allowed to mine, rootless wanderers will surely flock together and breed incidents.
translations.idiomatic: If private mining is allowed, rootless drifters will swarm in and incidents will follow.

sentences.zh: 速會同巡撫憲德將金竹坪、白蠟山諸地銅鉛礦廠概行封禁。

translations.literal: Quickly, together with Governor Xian De, seal off entirely the copper and lead mines at Jinzhuping, Baimoshan, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: At once, with Governor Xian De, seal every copper and lead works at Jinzhuping, Baimoshan, and the rest.

sentences.zh: 脫至紛紜，黃廷桂、憲德之身家性命不足贖其辜也！

translations.literal: If disorder should arise, the lives and property of Huang Tinggui and Xian De would not suffice to atone for their guilt!
translations.idiomatic: If trouble breaks out, neither Huang Tinggui nor Xian De could pay for it with their lives!

sentences.zh: 」廷桂奏引罪，復以詳慎申戒之。

translations.literal: " Tinggui memorialized accepting blame, and was again admonished to be thorough and cautious.
translations.idiomatic: " Tinggui submitted a confession; the emperor again urged him to be thorough and careful.

sentences.zh: 尋奏捕得妖言罪人楊大銘等，言其渠楊七匿酉陽土司所，已檄令擒獻。

translations.literal: Soon he reported the capture of the seditious preacher Yang Daming and others, stating that their ringleader Yang Qi was hiding with the Youyang native chieftain and that orders had been sent to seize and deliver him.
translations.idiomatic: He soon reported the arrest of Yang Daming and other sedition suspects, saying ringleader Yang Qi was hiding with the Youyang chieftain and that he had ordered him seized and sent in.

sentences.zh: 上諭曰：「此事尤宜詳慎！

translations.literal: The emperor instructed: "This matter especially requires thorough caution!
translations.idiomatic: The emperor warned: "This case above all demands care!

sentences.zh: 朕料酉陽土司未必為此事。

translations.literal: I surmise the Youyang chieftain is probably not involved in this affair.
translations.idiomatic: I doubt the Youyang chieftain had anything to do with it.

sentences.zh: 」八年，奏於楊隘嘴獲楊七，非酉陽境內。

translations.literal: " In the eighth year he reported that Yang Qi was captured at Yangyanzui, not within Youyang territory.
translations.idiomatic: " In the eighth year he reported Yang Qi taken at Yangyanzui, outside Youyang.

sentences.zh: 上諭曰：「朕非有過人技，但較汝等克誠克公耳。

translations.literal: The emperor instructed: "I have no surpassing skill, only that I am more able than you to be sincere and fair.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "I am not wiser than you—only more consistent in sincerity and fairness.

sentences.zh: 人有利害是非之心，遇事接物，非過即不及。

translations.literal: People have minds of private interest and partisan judgment; in dealing with affairs they either go too far or fall short.
translations.idiomatic: Men let private interest sway them and, in handling affairs, either overshoot or fall short.

sentences.zh: 惟公與誠為對證之藥。

translations.literal: Only fairness and sincerity are the medicine that answers to this.
translations.idiomatic: Fairness and sincerity are the only antidote.

sentences.zh: 」十二月，奏倮亂，發兵攻克金鎖關、黑鐵關、黃草坪諸地，恢復永善。

translations.literal: " In the twelfth month he reported a Lolo rebellion; troops were sent to capture Jinsuoguan, Heitieguan, Huangcaoping, and other places, and Yongshan was recovered.
translations.idiomatic: " In the twelfth month he reported a Yi uprising; troops retook Jinsuo Pass, Heitie Pass, Huangcaoping, and other posts and restored Yongshan.

sentences.zh: 得旨獎許。

translations.literal: He received an edict of commendation.
translations.idiomatic: The court praised him in an edict.

sentences.zh: 上嘗諭憲德，令密陳廷桂為人，奏稱「多疑偏聽，好勝矜人，是其病痛」。

translations.literal: The emperor once instructed Xian De to report confidentially on Tinggui's character; he memorialized that "suspicious and partial in listening, fond of winning and condescending to others—these are his ailments."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor once told Xian De to report privately on Tinggui's character; he wrote that "he is suspicious and hears only one side, loves to win and looks down on others—that is his weakness."

sentences.zh: 上終以實心任事嘉之。

translations.literal: The emperor in the end still commended him for serving with a sincere heart.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor still valued him for serving wholeheartedly.

sentences.zh: 九年，師討噶爾丹策零，分設四川總督，即以命廷桂，仍兼領提督。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, as the army campaigned against Galdan Tsering, a separate Sichuan governor-generalship was established and conferred on Tinggui, who still concurrently held the provincial military command.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, while troops campaigned against Galdan Tsering, a separate Sichuan governor-generalship was created and given to Tinggui, who retained the provincial military command as well.

sentences.zh: 奏請將四川常平倉捐穀改銀，上諭曰：「四川本產米地，積貯尚易。

translations.literal: He memorialized requesting that the grain contributed to Sichuan's ever-normal granaries be converted to silver; the emperor instructed: "Sichuan is originally a rice-producing region, and accumulation is still easy.
translations.idiomatic: He asked to convert grain contributions to Sichuan's ever-normal granaries into silver; the emperor replied: "Sichuan is a rice country—stockpiling grain is still straightforward.

sentences.zh: 遽請開捐，誤矣。

translations.literal: To rush to request opening contributions is mistaken.
translations.idiomatic: To rush to sell offices for grain is a mistake.

sentences.zh: 且欲改穀作銀，又將銀買穀，更轉展滋弊，當另議增貯。

translations.literal: Moreover, to wish to convert grain to silver and then use silver to buy grain only breeds more abuses through repeated exchanges; another plan for increasing stores should be discussed.
translations.idiomatic: Converting grain to silver only to buy grain back with silver invites fresh abuses; find another way to enlarge the reserves.

sentences.zh: 」十年六月，奏建昌鎮轄竹核，當涼山之中，為苗疆腹心要地，請於附近各險隘增兵設鎮，上命大學士鄂爾泰詳議。

translations.literal: " In the sixth month of the tenth year he reported that Zhuhe, under Jianchang garrison, lies in the center of Liangshan and is a vital point in the Miao frontier heartland, requesting increased troops and new garrisons at nearby strategic passes; the emperor ordered Grand Secretary Ortai to deliberate in detail.
translations.idiomatic: " In the sixth month of the tenth year he argued that Zhuhe, under Jianchang, sits in the heart of Liangshan and is the strategic core of the Miao frontier, and asked for more troops and posts at nearby passes; the emperor told Grand Secretary Ortai to review the plan.

sentences.zh: 尋議兵力宜合不宜分，蠻巢宜遠不宜近，但使我勢聯絡，不必隨處設防。

translations.literal: Soon it was decided that military strength should be concentrated rather than dispersed, and barbarian nests kept at a distance rather than approached; so long as our power is linked, there is no need to garrison every place.
translations.idiomatic: The review held that forces should be concentrated, not scattered, and tribal strongholds kept at arm's length; linked strength mattered more than posts everywhere.

sentences.zh: 請於竹核設兵三千，分駐吽姑、格落、魚紅、大赤口、阿都、沙馬、普雄諸地。

translations.literal: It was requested to station three thousand troops at Zhuhe, distributed among Honggu, Geluo, Yuhong, Dachikou, Adu, Shama, Puxiong, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: Three thousand men were to be based at Zhuhe and posted to Honggu, Geluo, Yuhong, Dachikou, Adu, Shama, Puxiong, and other points.

sentences.zh: 敕下廷桂行之。

translations.literal: An imperial order was issued for Tinggui to carry it out.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Tinggui to implement the plan.

sentences.zh: 八月，兒斯番為亂，奏遣總兵趙儒剿捕，上責廷桂從前未料理妥協。

translations.literal: In the eighth month the Ersi tribes rebelled; he memorialized dispatching Regional Commander Zhao Ru to suppress them, and the emperor reproached Tinggui for not having settled matters properly before.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month the Ersi tribes rose; he sent Regional Commander Zhao Ru to suppress them, and the emperor blamed Tinggui for not having handled the matter properly earlier.

sentences.zh: 十月，廷桂奏言：「雍正五年兒斯番為亂，臣檄副將王剛按治。

translations.literal: In the tenth month Tinggui memorialized: "In the fifth year of Yongzheng the Ersi tribes rebelled and I ordered Deputy Commander Wang Gang to deal with them.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Tinggui wrote: "When the Ersi tribes rebelled in Yongzheng 5, I ordered Deputy Commander Wang Gang to pacify them.

sentences.zh: 時臣甫到川，地利夷情尚未諳習。

translations.literal: At that time I had just arrived in Sichuan and was not yet familiar with the terrain and tribal conditions.
translations.idiomatic: I had only just reached Sichuan and did not yet know the ground or the tribes.

sentences.zh: 今兇鋒既肆，由臣撫馭無方，已遵旨密諭趙儒凜遵料理。

translations.literal: Now that the rebels' violence has broken out, it is because I governed them without method; I have already secretly instructed Zhao Ru in accordance with the edict to handle matters with strict obedience.
translations.idiomatic: Now that violence has flared again, the fault is mine for poor governance; I have secretly ordered Zhao Ru, as instructed, to handle the matter with utmost care.

sentences.zh: 」十二月，擒兒斯酋，並剿定河東各寨勾結諸番。

translations.literal: " In the twelfth month the Ersi chief was captured, and the tribes of the eastern-bank stockades who had joined in conspiracy were also suppressed and settled.
translations.idiomatic: " In the twelfth month the Ersi chief was taken and the eastern-bank stockades that had joined the rebels were pacified.

sentences.zh: 復奏言：「王剛前所懲創，不過兒斯一堡。

translations.literal: He again memorialized: "What Wang Gang punished before amounted only to one Ersi stockade.
translations.idiomatic: He added: "Wang Gang's earlier punishment had reached only one Ersi fort.

sentences.zh: 今仰蒙指示，趙儒督勵將士，一切險巢重地，深林石穴，悉行蕩平。

translations.literal: Now, relying on your guidance, Zhao Ru has urged on the officers and soldiers and swept clean every strategic nest, deep forest, and stone cave.
translations.idiomatic: Under your guidance Zhao Ru has driven the troops through every stronghold, forest, and cave until all were cleared.

sentences.zh: 」上深獎之。

translations.literal: " The emperor greatly commended him.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor warmly praised him.

sentences.zh: 十三年，奏：「貴州古州苗亂，四川建昌、永寧俱與連界，已飭將吏加意撫輯。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he memorialized: "The Miao of Guzhou in Guizhou have rebelled; Jianchang and Yongning in Sichuan both border the area, and officers have been ordered to pay special attention to pacification.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he reported: "Guzhou Miao in Guizhou have risen; Jianchang and Yongning in Sichuan border the region, and I have told local officers to pacify the frontier with extra care.

sentences.zh: 」上諭以「不動聲色，靜鎮慎密」。

translations.literal: " The emperor instructed him to "show no outward agitation, keep calm restraint, and act with careful secrecy."
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor told him to "keep quiet, hold the line calmly, and act with discretion."

sentences.zh: 乾隆元年，裁總督缺，廷桂仍為提督。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qianlong the governor-general post was abolished, and Tinggui remained provincial military commander.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 1 the governor-generalship was cut, and Tinggui stayed on as provincial military commander.

sentences.zh: 十二月，召詣京師。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month he was summoned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month he was called to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 二年，授鑾儀使。

translations.literal: In the second year he was appointed director of the imperial equipage.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he was made director of the imperial equipage.

sentences.zh: 尋授天津總兵。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was appointed regional commander of Tianjin.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon made regional commander at Tianjin.

sentences.zh: 五年，遷古北口提督。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was transferred to provincial military commander of Gubeikou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was transferred to Gubeikou as provincial military commander.

sentences.zh: 六年，上幸熱河，道古北口，閱兵，營伍整肅​​，賜廷桂馬，並上用緞。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, when the emperor visited Rehe by way of Gubeikou and reviewed the troops, the camps were in good order; he bestowed a horse on Tinggui and also imperial satin for his own use.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, on the emperor's journey to Rehe via Gubeikou, he inspected the troops and found the camps in excellent order; he gave Tinggui a horse and imperial satin for his own use.

sentences.zh: 尋授甘肅巡撫。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was appointed Gansu provincial governor.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon appointed governor of Gansu.

sentences.zh: 十二年，署陝甘總督。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he served as acting governor-general of Shaanxi and Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year he acted as governor-general of Shaanxi-Gansu.

sentences.zh: 十三年，授兩江總督。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he was appointed governor-general of the Two Jiangs.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he was made governor-general of the Two Jiangs.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「江西俗悍，有司因循姑息，動輒喧閧，飭嚴捕究治。

translations.literal: In a memorial he stated: "The people of Jiangxi are by custom fierce; officials indulge them with lax forbearance, and disturbances break out at every turn; strict arrest and punishment have been ordered.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized: "Jiangxi folk are unruly; officials have been too indulgent, and riots break out constantly—I have ordered vigorous arrests and prosecutions.

sentences.zh: 」又言：「南方晴少雨多，各營操練閒曠，令於陰雨時擇公所或寬敞寺宇操練。

translations.literal: " He also stated: "In the south clear days are few and rainy days many; drill in the various camps lies idle; orders have been issued that on rainy days drill be held in public halls or spacious temples.
translations.idiomatic: " He also noted that in the south rain keeps troops from drilling outdoors and ordered rainy-day drill in public halls or large temples.

sentences.zh: 」上諭曰：「汝至江南，整飭振作，但不可欲速，要之以久可也。

translations.literal: " The emperor instructed: "When you reach Jiangnan, put things in order and rouse them, but you must not seek speed; what matters is persistence over time.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor told him: "When you reach the south, set things right and revive discipline, but do not hurry—steady work over time is what counts.

sentences.zh: 」十五年，太子少保。

translations.literal: " In the fifteenth year he was made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: " In the fifteenth year he received the title Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 疏劾「江蘇巡撫雅爾哈善以奏銷錢糧，奉旨訓飭；

translations.literal: In a memorial of impeachment he stated: "Jiangsu Governor Yeerhashan, having reported the settlement of tax grain accounts, received an imperial reprimand;
translations.idiomatic: He impeached Jiangsu governor Yeerhashan, writing that after Yeerhashan reported on tax-grain accounts the emperor had rebuked him;

sentences.zh: 知縣許惟枚等經徵未完，不及一分，例止罰俸。

translations.literal: the district magistrates Xu Weimei and others had not completed collection, falling short by less than one percent, for which the regulation provides only salary forfeiture.
translations.idiomatic: yet magistrates such as Xu Weimei were short by less than one percent on collection, which by regulation merits only a fine in salary.

sentences.zh: 忽奏請奪官。

translations.literal: Suddenly he memorialized requesting their dismissal from office.
translations.idiomatic: Suddenly he asked that their offices be stripped.

sentences.zh: 人必以為出自上意，居心巧詐」。

translations.literal: People will surely think this came from the emperor's own intent—his mind is crafty and deceitful."
translations.idiomatic: People will assume the emperor ordered it—his conduct is devious."

sentences.zh: 雅爾哈善下吏議。

translations.literal: Yeerhashan was handed over to the judicial authorities for investigation.
translations.idiomatic: Yeerhashan was referred to the judicial authorities for investigation.

sentences.zh: 十六年，調陝甘總督。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he was transferred to governor-general of Shaanxi and Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year he was transferred to Shaanxi-Gansu as governor-general.

sentences.zh: 時四川復分設總督，十八年，仍以命廷桂。

translations.literal: At that time a separate Sichuan governor-generalship was again established, and in the eighteenth year the post was again conferred on Tinggui.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan again received its own governor-general, and in the eighteenth year Tinggui was appointed to it once more.

sentences.zh: 奏四川歲豐穀賤，上命轉輸二十萬石賑淮、揚被水州縣，御製詩紀其事。

translations.literal: He reported that Sichuan had a bountiful year and cheap grain; the emperor ordered two hundred thousand piculs transported to relieve the flood-stricken prefectures and districts of Huai and Yang, and composed an imperial poem to record the event.
translations.idiomatic: He reported a bumper harvest and cheap grain in Sichuan; the emperor ordered two hundred thousand piculs sent to flood-hit Huai-Yang districts and wrote a poem to commemorate the relief effort.

sentences.zh: 進吏部尚書，留總督任。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Minister of Personnel while retaining his governor-general duties.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Minister of Personnel but kept his governor-general post.

sentences.zh: 四川濱江諸縣引江水溉田。

translations.literal: The counties along the rivers in Sichuan draw river water to irrigate the fields.
translations.idiomatic: Riverine counties in Sichuan irrigate their fields from the Yangzi and its tributaries.

sentences.zh: 餘多山田，每苦旱。

translations.literal: The rest are mostly hillside fields and often suffer from drought.
translations.idiomatic: Most of the remainder is upland fields, which often suffer drought.

sentences.zh: 廷桂奏飭通省勘修塘堰，新都、蘆山等十州縣及青神蓮花壩、樂山平江鄉、三台南明鎮次第修舉，悉成腴壤。

translations.literal: Tinggui memorialized ordering inspection and repair of ponds and dikes throughout the province; in Xindu, Lushan, and ten other prefectures and counties, as well as Lianhuaba in Qingshen, Pingjiang township in Leshan, and Nanming town in Santai, works were carried out in turn and all became fertile land.
translations.idiomatic: Tinggui ordered a province-wide survey and repair of ponds and dikes; in Xindu, Lushan, and ten other counties, and at sites such as Lianhuaba, Pingjiang, and Nanming, works proceeded in turn until the land became richly productive.

sentences.zh: 二十年，奏請增爐鑄錢，為通省修城。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year he memorialized requesting additional mint furnaces to cast coin for repairing city walls throughout the province.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year he asked to add mint furnaces to fund wall repairs across the province.

sentences.zh: 上諭曰：「有益地方之事，詳妥為之。

translations.literal: The emperor instructed: "For matters that benefit the region, carry them out in thorough and proper fashion.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor replied: "If it helps the province, plan it carefully and carry it through properly.

sentences.zh: 」授武英殿大學士，仍領總督事。

translations.literal: " He was appointed Grand Secretary of the Hall of Military Glory while still directing governor-general affairs.
translations.idiomatic: " He was made a Grand Secretary of the Hall of Military Glory but kept his governor-general duties.

sentences.zh: 打箭爐徼外孔撒、麻書兩土司構釁，金川、綽斯甲布袒麻書，革布什咱、德爾格忒袒孔撒，互攻殺。

translations.literal: Beyond the frontier post of Dartsedo the two native chieftains of Kongsa and Mashu provoked trouble; Jinchuan and Chosichab sided with Mashu, while Gebushizan and Dege sided with Kongsa, and they attacked and killed one another.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond Dartsedo the Kongsa and Mashu chieftains quarreled; Jinchuan and Chosichab backed Mashu while Gebushizan and Dege backed Kongsa, and they raided one another.

sentences.zh: 廷桂偕提督岳鍾琪飭諭解散。

translations.literal: Tinggui together with Provincial Military Commander Yue Zhongqi ordered them admonished to disperse.
translations.idiomatic: Tinggui and Provincial Commander Yue Zhongqi ordered them to stand down.

sentences.zh: 六月，復調陝甘總督。

translations.literal: In the sixth month he was again transferred to governor-general of Shaanxi and Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month he was transferred back to Shaanxi-Gansu as governor-general.

sentences.zh: 師討阿睦爾撒納，陝、甘當轉輸孔道。

translations.literal: As the army campaigned against Amursana, Shaanxi and Gansu formed the vital corridor for transport.
translations.idiomatic: While troops campaigned against Amursana, Shaanxi and Gansu became the main supply corridor.

sentences.zh: 廷桂途次以軍中調取營馬，並令州縣采買馬駝，即飭各驛馬十調五六，得馬數千匹佐軍。

translations.literal: En route Tinggui requisitioned camp horses for the army and ordered prefectures and counties to purchase horses and camels; he immediately ordered from each post station five or six out of every ten horses, obtaining several thousand horses to assist the army.
translations.idiomatic: On the road he requisitioned camp horses and ordered local governments to buy horses and camels; he took five or six horses from every ten at each post and mustered several thousand for the army.

sentences.zh: 尋奏軍中文報，責成沿邊提鎮料理，詔如所請。

translations.literal: Soon he memorialized on military dispatches and made the frontier provincial commanders and regional commanders responsible for handling them; an edict approved his request.
translations.idiomatic: He soon reported on military dispatches and put frontier commanders in charge; the court agreed.

sentences.zh: 二十一年四月，命駐肅州督辦軍需。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the twenty-first year he was ordered to station at Suzhou and supervise military supplies.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the twenty-first year he was stationed at Suzhou to oversee military supplies.

sentences.zh: 奏言：「各處調解軍馬，口外嚴寒，自安西至哈密，經戈壁十餘站，飼飲不時，每致疲斃。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "Horses and camels dispatched from various places, beyond the passes in severe cold, from Anxi to Hami across more than ten Gobi stations, are not fed and watered in time and often die of exhaustion.
translations.idiomatic: He wrote: "Horses and camels sent from all directions cross the bitter cold beyond the passes; from Anxi to Hami they pass more than ten Gobi stations without timely fodder and water and often die on the road.

sentences.zh: 現派專官分站料理，將積貯草豆、經過匹數、住歇時刻、行走臕分，按日呈報。

translations.literal: Special officers have now been assigned to each station to manage matters; stores of hay and beans, numbers passing through, times of rest, and stages of travel are reported daily.
translations.idiomatic: I have assigned officers at each station to manage fodder stores, counts of animals passing through, rest times, and daily stages, with daily reports.

sentences.zh: 」又奏：「山西解駝，先留安西牧放。

translations.literal: " He also memorialized: "Camels dispatched from Shanxi are first kept at Anxi for pasturing.
translations.idiomatic: " He added: "Camels from Shanxi are pastured first at Anxi.

sentences.zh: 陝西解馬，亦先調甘肅飼養。

translations.literal: Horses dispatched from Shaanxi are likewise first sent to Gansu for feeding.
translations.idiomatic: Horses from Shaanxi are fed first in Gansu.

sentences.zh: 陸續前運，以濟實用。

translations.literal: They are then forwarded in succession to meet actual needs.
translations.idiomatic: They are then sent forward in stages as needed.

sentences.zh: 」先後送軍前駝馬七萬餘。

translations.literal: " In all more than seventy thousand camels and horses were sent to the front.
translations.idiomatic: " In all he forwarded more than seventy thousand camels and horses to the army.

sentences.zh: 又言：「西北兩路軍​​營向通商販，後因撤兵禁止。

translations.literal: He also stated: "The northwestern army camps on both routes formerly allowed trade, but after troops were withdrawn trade was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: He also noted that the northwestern camps had once allowed trade, but the ban remained after troops were withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 巴里坤軍營應用牛羊諸物，專自肅州販往，路遠價昂，難資接濟，請照舊通商。

translations.literal: The Barkol camp needs cattle, sheep, and other goods supplied solely from Suzhou; the route is long and prices high, making steady supply difficult; he requested restoration of trade as before.
translations.idiomatic: The Barkol camp relies on cattle and sheep brought only from Suzhou; the route is long and costly, so he asked that trade be reopened as before.

sentences.zh: 」上命籌濟庫車、阿克蘇糧運。

translations.literal: " The emperor ordered planning for grain transport to Kucha and Aksu.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor ordered him to organize grain shipments to Kucha and Aksu.

sentences.zh: 廷桂奏：「夾山一路，可自哈密直趨闢展、吐魯番，其間騾駝通行，水草饒裕，較繞行巴里坤為近。

translations.literal: Tinggui memorialized: "By the mountain-pass route one can go straight from Hami to Karashahr and Turfan; mules and camels can pass along it, water and fodder are abundant, and it is shorter than going by way of Barkol.
translations.idiomatic: Tinggui proposed the mountain route from Hami straight to Karashahr and Turfan, where pack animals could travel with ample water and fodder—a shorter line than via Barkol.

sentences.zh: 擬即運糧貯吐魯番，轉運軍營，往返更加迅速。

translations.literal: It is proposed to transport grain immediately and store it at Turfan, then forward it to the camps, making round trips still faster.
translations.idiomatic: Grain would be stored at Turfan and forwarded to the camps, shortening the round trip.

sentences.zh: 」又發銀二十萬，解阿克蘇買回城米，運糧十萬儲巴里坤。

translations.literal: " He also disbursed two hundred thousand taels of silver, sent to Aksu to buy grain from returning Muslims, and transported one hundred thousand piculs of grain stored at Barkol.
translations.idiomatic: " He also sent two hundred thousand taels to Aksu to buy grain from the returning Muslims and stored one hundred thousand piculs at Barkol.

sentences.zh: 凡所經畫，屢合上指。

translations.literal: In all his planning he repeatedly matched the emperor's intent.
translations.idiomatic: His plans repeatedly matched what the emperor had in mind.

sentences.zh: 十二月，上諭曰：「廷桂於西陲用兵，雖未身歷行陣，而籌辦軍需，每有朕旨未到，旋即奏至，與所規畫不約而同。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month the emperor instructed: "In the western campaign Tinggui, though he did not personally go through the ranks, in provisioning the army his memorials often arrived as soon as an edict was drafted, matching my plans without prior agreement.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month the emperor said: "In the western war Tinggui never took the field, yet in supply his memorials often reached me before my orders were drafted, matching my own plans uncannily.

sentences.zh: 體國奉公，精詳妥協，而又毫不累民，內地若無兵事，其功最大。

translations.literal: He embodies service to the state and the public good, is meticulous and thorough, and yet does not burden the people at all; in the interior it is as if there were no war—his merit is greatest.
translations.idiomatic: He served the state with care and precision yet never burdened the people; inland it was as if there were no war—that was his greatest achievement.

sentences.zh: 」積功自太子太保進少保，自騎都尉進三等忠勤伯，先後賜雙眼孔雀翎、紅寶石帽頂、四團龍補服、白金二萬。

translations.literal: " For accumulated merit he was advanced from Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent to Guardian, from Commandant of Cavalry to third-class Baron of Loyal Diligence, and was successively bestowed double-eyed peacock feathers, a ruby hat knob, a four-dragon roundel surcoat, and twenty thousand taels of white silver.
translations.idiomatic: " For his service he rose from Junior to full Guardian of the Heir Apparent and from Commandant of Cavalry to third-class Baron of Loyal Diligence, and received double-eyed peacock feathers, a ruby hat knob, a four-dragon surcoat, and twenty thousand taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 二十四年正月，駐涼州，以病劇聞。

translations.literal: In the first month of the twenty-fourth year, while stationed at Liangzhou, word came that his illness was severe.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the twenty-fourth year, stationed at Liangzhou, he was reported gravely ill.

sentences.zh: 命額駙福隆安率御醫診視，甫行，廷桂卒。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Imperial Son-in-law Fu Longan to lead court physicians to examine him; he had only set out when Tinggui died.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sent Imperial Son-in-law Fu Longan with court physicians, but Tinggui died before they arrived.

sentences.zh: 上即命福隆​​安奠醊，御製詩輓之，賜祭葬，諡文襄。

translations.literal: The emperor immediately ordered Fu Longan to offer libations, composed an imperial elegy, granted funeral rites, and gave the posthumous title Wenxiang.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor at once ordered Fu Longan to offer libations, wrote an elegy, granted state funeral honors, and gave him the posthumous name Wenxiang.

sentences.zh: 喪還，上复親臨奠醊。

translations.literal: When the coffin returned, the emperor again came in person to offer libations.
translations.idiomatic: When the coffin returned home, the emperor again offered libations in person.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，凱宴成功將士，追念廷桂，复賦詩惜之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year, at the victory banquet for successful officers and soldiers, he recalled Tinggui and again composed a poem lamenting him.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year, at the victory banquet for the successful generals, he remembered Tinggui and wrote another poem in mourning.

sentences.zh: 尋命圖形紫光閣，御製懷舊詩，列廷桂五督臣首。

translations.literal: Soon he ordered his portrait placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor, composed an imperial poem recalling old companions, and listed Tinggui first among the five governor-generals.
translations.idiomatic: He soon had Tinggui's portrait placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor, wrote a poem of remembrance, and ranked him first among five governor-generals.

sentences.zh: 孫檢，官副都統。

translations.literal: His grandson Jian served as vice commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: His grandson Jian rose to vice commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 乾隆四十九年，以刻廷桂奏疏，載兩朝批答，被嚴旨申飭。

translations.literal: In the forty-ninth year of Qianlong, for printing Tinggui's memorials with imperial responses from two reigns, he received a stern edict of reprimand.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 49 he was sharply rebuked for publishing Tinggui's memorials together with imperial responses from two reigns.

sentences.zh: 曾孫文煜，自侍衛累擢副都統，調馬蘭鎮總兵。

translations.literal: His great-grandson Wenyu, starting as a bodyguard, was repeatedly promoted to vice commander-in-chief and transferred to regional commander of Malan garrison.
translations.idiomatic: His great-grandson Wenyu rose from bodyguard to vice commander-in-chief and was made regional commander at Malan.

sentences.zh: =鄂彌達=鄂彌達，鄂濟氏，滿洲正白旗人。

translations.literal: E Mida, of the Eje clan, was a Manchu of the Plain White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: E Mida, of the Eje clan, was a Manchu bannerman of the Plain White Banner.

sentences.zh: 初授戶部筆帖式。

translations.literal: He was first appointed a clerical secretary in the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: He began as a clerical secretary in the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 雍正元年，授吏部主事。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongzheng he was appointed a secretary in the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 1 he became a secretary in the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 累遷郎中。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to director.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through the ranks to director.

sentences.zh: 五年，命同廣東巡撫楊文乾等如福建察倉庫。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was ordered, together with Guangdong Governor Yang Wenqian and others, to go to Fujian to inspect the granaries.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was sent with Guangdong governor Yang Wenqian and others to inspect Fujian granaries.

sentences.zh: 六年，擢貴州布政使。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he was promoted to Guizhou provincial administration commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he was made Guizhou administration commissioner.

sentences.zh: 八年，遷廣東巡撫。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was transferred to Guangdong provincial governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he became governor of Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「鳥槍例有禁，瓊州民恃槍禦盜，請戶得藏一，多者罪之。

translations.literal: In a memorial he stated: "Firearms are prohibited by regulation, but Qiongzhou people rely on guns to repel bandits; it is requested that each household be allowed to keep one, with punishment for those who keep more.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized: "Firearms are banned by law, but Qiongzhou people depend on them against bandits; allow one per household and punish excess.

sentences.zh: 」梧州民陳美倫等謀亂，捕治如法。

translations.literal: " Chen Meilun and others of Wuzhou plotted rebellion and were arrested and punished according to law.
translations.idiomatic: " Chen Meilun and other Wuzhou plotters were arrested and punished by law.

sentences.zh: 十年，署廣東總督。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he served as acting governor-general of Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he acted as governor-general of Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「總督舊駐肇慶，所以控制兩粵。

translations.literal: In a memorial he stated: "The governor-general formerly resided at Zhaoqing in order to control both Guangdong and Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: He argued that the governor-general had once resided at Zhaoqing to oversee both Guangdong and Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 今專督廣東，應請移駐廣州。

translations.literal: Now that he supervises Guangdong alone, he should be requested to move his residence to Guangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Now that the post oversees Guangdong alone, he asked to move the seat to Guangzhou.

sentences.zh: 」饒平武舉餘猊等謀亂，捕治如法。

translations.literal: " Yu Ni and other military licentiates of Raoping plotted rebellion and were arrested and punished according to law.
translations.idiomatic: " Yu Ni and other Raoping military licentiates who plotted rebellion were arrested and punished.

sentences.zh: 尋實授總督。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was appointed governor-general in full capacity.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon confirmed as governor-general.

sentences.zh: 安南民鄧文武等遇風入銅鼓角海面，鄂彌達畀以資，送歸國，國王以伽南、沉香諸物為謝，卻之，疏聞，上獎其得體。

translations.literal: Deng Wenwu and other Annamese, blown by wind into the sea off Tonggujiao, were given supplies by E Mida and sent home; the king offered agarwood, eaglewood, and other goods in thanks, which he declined, reporting in a memorial; the emperor praised his propriety.
translations.idiomatic: When Annamese including Deng Wenwu were blown by storm into waters off Tonggujiao, E Mida supplied them and sent them home; the king offered agarwood and eaglewood in thanks, which he refused and reported; the emperor praised his tact.

sentences.zh: 先後疏請移設將吏。

translations.literal: He successively memorialized requesting the transfer and establishment of military officers and civil officials.
translations.idiomatic: He repeatedly asked to reposition military and civil officials.

sentences.zh: 又疏請於三水西南鎮建倉貯穀，並以米貴，會城設局平糶。

translations.literal: He also memorialized requesting construction of a granary at Xinanzhen in Sanshui to store grain, and because rice was dear, establishment of a relief-sale bureau in the provincial capital.
translations.idiomatic: He also asked for a granary at Xinanzhen in Sanshui and, because rice was dear, a relief-sale office in the provincial capital.

sentences.zh: 又請升程鄉縣為直隸州，名曰嘉應。

translations.literal: He also requested promotion of Chengxiang county to a directly administered prefecture named Jiaying.
translations.idiomatic: He also asked that Chengxiang county be raised to a directly administered prefecture named Jiaying.

sentences.zh: 皆報可。

translations.literal: All were approved.
translations.idiomatic: All were approved.

sentences.zh: 十三年，命兼轄廣西，仍駐肇慶。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he was ordered to supervise Guangxi as well, still residing at Zhaoqing.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he was given Guangxi as well and remained at Zhaoqing.

sentences.zh: 貴州台拱苗亂，鄂彌達發兵令左江總兵王無黨率以赴援，復發兵駐黔、粵界，上諭獎之。

translations.literal: When the Miao of Taigong in Guizhou rebelled, E Mida dispatched troops and ordered Zuojiang Regional Commander Wang Wudang to lead them to aid; he also sent troops to garrison the Guizhou-Guangdong border, and the emperor commended him in an edict.
translations.idiomatic: When Taigong Miao in Guizhou rebelled, E Mida sent troops under Zuojiang commander Wang Wudang to assist and posted troops on the Guizhou-Guangdong border; the emperor praised him.

sentences.zh: 乾隆元年，高宗命近鹽場貧民販鹽毋禁。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qianlong the Gaozong Emperor ordered that poor people near salt fields be not forbidden to sell salt.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 1 the Qianlong emperor ordered that poor people near salt works be allowed to sell salt.

sentences.zh: 鄂彌達疏言：「廣東按察使白映棠未遵旨分別，老幼男婦發票，稱四十斤以下不許緝捕，致奸徒藉口，成群販私。

translations.literal: E Mida memorialized: "Guangdong Provincial Surveillance Commissioner Bai Yingtang did not follow the edict to make distinctions; he issued permits to old and young, men and women alike, and declared that amounts under forty jin might not be seized, so villains took this as a pretext and sold salt illicitly in groups.
translations.idiomatic: E Mida reported that Guangdong surveillance commissioner Bai Yingtang had ignored the edict's distinctions, issued permits to everyone including women and children, and forbade seizure of loads under forty jin, giving smugglers a pretext to operate in gangs.

sentences.zh: 」上獎鄂彌達洞悉政體，解映棠任。

translations.literal: " The emperor praised E Mida for understanding the principles of government and removed Yingtang from office.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor praised E Mida's grasp of policy and removed Bai Yingtang from office.

sentences.zh: 尋奏：「廣東鹽由埸配運省河及潮州廣濟橋轉兌各埠，請令到埠先完餉銀，開倉後繳鹽價。

translations.literal: Soon he memorialized: "Guangdong salt is allocated from the salterns and transported on the provincial river and exchanged at various depots via the Guangji Bridge in Chaozhou; it is requested that upon arrival at a depot the salt tax silver be paid first, and the salt price paid only after the warehouse is opened.
translations.idiomatic: He soon proposed that Guangdong salt, shipped from salterns via the provincial river and exchanged at depots through Chaozhou's Guangji Bridge, be taxed at the depot before warehouse release and the salt price paid only afterward.

sentences.zh: 」下部議行。

translations.literal: " The ministries deliberated and carried it out.
translations.idiomatic: " The ministries approved and implemented it.

sentences.zh: 御史薛馧條奏廣西團練鄉勇，並設瑤童義學，下鄂彌達議。

translations.literal: Censor Xue Yun memorialized in separate items on Guangxi militia training and village defense, and on establishing charity schools for Yao children; the matter was referred to E Mida for deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Xue Yun proposed Guangxi militia training and charity schools for Yao children; the court referred the matter to E Mida.

sentences.zh: 二年，奏言：「團練鄉勇，不若訓練土司兵，於邊疆有益。

translations.literal: In the second year he memorialized: "Militia and village defense are inferior to training native-chieftain troops, which is more beneficial on the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he argued that training native-chieftain troops would serve the frontier better than village militia.

sentences.zh: 瑤童義學，韶、連等屬已有成效，應如馧所奏。

translations.literal: Charity schools for Yao children in Shaozhou, Lianzhou, and other jurisdictions have already shown results and should follow what Yun memorialized.
translations.idiomatic: Charity schools for Yao children in Shaozhou and Lianzhou were already working and should follow Xue Yun's proposal.

sentences.zh: 」尋又疏言：「惠、潮、嘉應三府州民多請州縣給票，移家入川。

translations.literal: " Soon he again memorialized: "In the three prefectures of Huizhou, Chaozhou, and Jiaying many people request permits from prefectures and counties to move their families into Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: " He soon reported that many people in Huizhou, Chaozhou, and Jiaying were asking local officials for permits to move their families to Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 臣飭州縣不得濫給，並遣吏於界上察驗。

translations.literal: I have ordered prefectures and counties not to issue permits indiscriminately, and have sent officials to inspect at the border.
translations.idiomatic: I have forbidden indiscriminate issuance and sent officers to inspect at the border.

sentences.zh: 」又疏言：「貴州新闢苗疆，總督張廣泗奏設屯軍墾田。

translations.literal: " He also memorialized: "In the newly opened Miao frontier of Guizhou, Governor-General Zhang Guangsi memorialized establishing garrison colonists to reclaim land.
translations.idiomatic: " He also objected to Governor-General Zhang Guangsi's plan to station colonist troops on newly opened Miao lands in Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 臣以今苗畏威安貼，將來生齒漸繁，地少人多，必致生怨。

translations.literal: I consider that though the Miao now fear authority and are settled, in future as population grows and land is scarce while people are many, resentment will surely arise.
translations.idiomatic: The Miao are quiet now, but as their numbers grow on limited land, resentment will follow.

sentences.zh: 又恐屯軍虐苗激變，請撤屯軍於附近防守，其田仍給苗民。

translations.literal: I also fear that garrison colonists will abuse the Miao and provoke rebellion; I request withdrawing the colonists to garrison nearby for defense while the land is still given to the Miao people.
translations.idiomatic: I also fear colonist troops will mistreat the Miao and provoke revolt; withdraw them to nearby garrisons and leave the land to the Miao.

sentences.zh: 」上諭曰：「所見甚正。

translations.literal: " The emperor instructed: "Your view is entirely correct.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor replied: "Your judgment is sound.

sentences.zh: 廣泗首尾承辦此事，持之甚力，朕則以為終非長策也。

translations.literal: Guangsi has handled this matter from start to finish and held to it very firmly, but I consider that in the end it is not a lasting policy.
translations.idiomatic: Guangsi has pushed this hard from beginning to end, but I do not think it will work in the long run.

sentences.zh: 四年，調川陝總督。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was transferred to governor-general of Sichuan and Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he was transferred to Sichuan-Shaanxi as governor-general.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「榆林邊民歲往鄂爾多斯種地，牛具、籽種、日用皆貸於鄂爾多斯。

translations.literal: In a memorial he stated: "Frontier people of Yulin go each year to plant fields in Ordos; oxen, tools, seed, and daily needs are all borrowed from the Ordos Mongols.
translations.idiomatic: He reported that Yulin frontier farmers yearly planted in Ordos and borrowed oxen, seed, and supplies from the Mongols there.

sentences.zh: 秋收餘糧，易牛羊皮入內地變價，重息還債。

translations.literal: After the autumn harvest the surplus grain is exchanged for cattle, sheep, and hides brought into the interior to sell at a profit, and the debt is repaid at heavy interest.
translations.idiomatic: After harvest they traded surplus grain for livestock and hides sold inland at profit to repay loans at usurious rates.

sentences.zh: 請於出口時視種地多寡，藉以官銀，秋收以糧抵，俾免借貸折耗之苦，倉儲亦可漸充。

translations.literal: It is requested that at the time of departure, according to the amount of land to be planted, official silver be lent; at harvest grain may be used to repay, so as to spare them the suffering of borrowing at ruinous rates, and granary stores may also gradually be replenished.
translations.idiomatic: He asked that official silver be lent at departure according to acreage and repaid in grain at harvest, sparing farmers usurious loans while gradually filling granaries.

sentences.zh: 」上從之。

translations.literal: " The emperor approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor agreed.

sentences.zh: 又請發司庫銀十萬買穀分貯沿邊，又請修寧夏渠道，並加築沿河長堤。

translations.literal: He also requested disbursement of one hundred thousand taels from the provincial treasury to buy grain for storage along the frontier, repair of the Ningxia irrigation channels, and additional construction of long dikes along the river.
translations.idiomatic: He also asked for one hundred thousand taels to buy frontier grain reserves, repairs to Ningxia's irrigation channels, and reinforcement of river dikes.

sentences.zh: 又奏：「安西鎮遠兵駐防哈密，承種屯田，在城兵僅數百。

translations.literal: He also memorialized: "Anxi Zhenyuan troops garrison Hami and undertake military colonies; troops in the city number only a few hundred.
translations.idiomatic: He also reported that Anxi Zhenyuan troops garrisoned Hami on military colonies while only a few hundred soldiers remained in the city.

sentences.zh: 年來商民日增，請視涼州柳林湖例，募流民及營兵子弟墾田，撤兵回城差操。

translations.literal: In recent years merchants and civilians have increased daily; it is requested that following the precedent of Liulinhu in Liangzhou, displaced persons and sons of camp soldiers be recruited to reclaim land, and troops withdrawn to the city for rotation duties.
translations.idiomatic: As merchants and settlers increased, he proposed following the Liulinhu precedent in Liangzhou: recruit refugees and soldiers' sons to farm and pull troops back to the city for rotation.

sentences.zh: 」均如議行。

translations.literal: " All were carried out as deliberated.
translations.idiomatic: " All were approved and implemented.

sentences.zh: 五年，兩廣總督馬爾泰劾知府袁安煜放債病民，並及鄂彌達縱僕佔煤山事。

translations.literal: In the fifth year Governor-General Maertai of the Two Guangs impeached Prefect Yuan Anyu for lending money and harming the people, and also implicated E Mida for allowing his servants to seize coal mountains.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year Two Guangs governor-general Maertai impeached prefect Yuan Anyu for usurious lending and also accused E Mida of letting servants seize coal hills.

sentences.zh: 上解鄂彌達任，召詣京師。

translations.literal: The emperor relieved E Mida of his post and summoned him to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor removed E Mida from office and summoned him to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 尋授兵部侍郎。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was appointed vice minister of war.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon made vice minister of war.

sentences.zh: 六年，授寧古塔將軍，調荊州。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he was appointed general of Ningguta and transferred to Jingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he was made general of Ningguta and transferred to Jingzhou.

sentences.zh: 九年，授湖廣總督。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he was appointed governor-general of Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he was made governor-general of Huguang.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「武、漢濱江城郭民田，賴有堤以障。

translations.literal: In a memorial he stated: "The cities, towns, and civilian fields along the rivers at Wuhan depend on dikes for protection.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized that Wuhan's cities and farmland along the rivers depended on dikes for protection.

sentences.zh: 請於武昌蕎麥灣增築大堤，安陸沙洋大堤增築月堤，襄陽老龍石堤加備歲修銀。

translations.literal: It is requested to build a major dike at Qiaomaiwan in Wuchang, add moon dikes to the major dike at Shayang in Anlu, and increase annual repair funds for the Laolongshi dike in Xiangyang.
translations.idiomatic: He asked for a major dike at Qiaomaiwan in Wuchang, moon dikes at Shayang in Anlu, and added annual repair funds for Laolongshi dike in Xiangyang.

sentences.zh: 」十一年，上以鄂彌達不稱封疆，召詣京師。

translations.literal: " In the eleventh year, because E Mida was not equal to his frontier post, the emperor summoned him to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: " In the eleventh year the emperor found him unfit for frontier duty and recalled him to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 十五年，授吏部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he was appointed vice minister of personnel.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year he was made vice minister of personnel.

sentences.zh: 十六年，授鑲藍旗漢軍都統。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he was appointed commander-in-chief of the Han military Bordered Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year he was made commander-in-chief of the Han military Bordered Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 二十年，授刑部尚書，署直隸總督。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year he was appointed Minister of Justice and served as acting governor-general of Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year he was made Minister of Justice and acting governor-general of Zhili.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，兼管吏部尚書、協辦大學士。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year he concurrently directed the Ministry of Personnel and served as associate grand secretary.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year he also headed the Ministry of Personnel and served as associate grand secretary.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，加太子太保。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year he was given the additional title Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year he received the title Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，卒，予白金二千治喪，賜祭葬，諡文恭。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year he died; two thousand taels of white silver were granted for funeral arrangements, state funeral rites were bestowed, and the posthumous title Wengong was given.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year he died; the court granted two thousand taels for his funeral, state honors, and the posthumous name Wengong.

sentences.zh: =楊廷璋=楊廷璋，字奉峨，漢軍鑲黃旗人。

translations.literal: Yang Tingzhang, style name Fenge, was a Han military bannerman of the Bordered Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Tingzhang, whose style was Fenge, belonged to the Han military contingent of the Bordered Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 世襲佐領。

translations.literal: He inherited the post of company commander.
translations.idiomatic: He held an hereditary company command.

sentences.zh: 雍正七年，自筆帖式授工部主事。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Yongzheng, from clerical secretary he was appointed a secretary in the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 7 he rose from clerical secretary to secretary in the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 再遷郎中。

translations.literal: He was again promoted to director.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted again, this time to director in the ministry.

sentences.zh: 授廣西桂林知府。

translations.literal: He was appointed prefect of Guilin in Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: He received appointment as prefect of Guilin, Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二年，擢左江道。

translations.literal: In the second year of Qianlong he was promoted to intendant of Zuojiang Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 2 he was elevated to intendant of the Zuojiang Circuit.

sentences.zh: 十五年，擢按察使。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he was promoted provincial judicial commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year he rose to provincial judicial commissioner.

sentences.zh: 二十年，遷湖南布政使。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year he was transferred to Hunan provincial treasurer.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year he moved to the post of Hunan provincial treasurer.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，授浙江巡撫。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year he was appointed Zhejiang provincial governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year he became Zhejiang provincial governor.

sentences.zh: 上南巡，諭曰：「西湖水民間藉以溉田。

translations.literal: When the emperor toured the south, he instructed: "The waters of West Lake are relied upon by the people for irrigating fields.
translations.idiomatic: On a southern tour the emperor directed: "Common folk depend on West Lake water to irrigate their fields.

sentences.zh: 今聞沿湖多佔墾，湖身漸壅，田畝虞涸竭。

translations.literal: Now it is heard that much encroachment and reclamation occur along the lake, the lake bed is gradually silting up, and the fields fear drying up.
translations.idiomatic: I hear that extensive encroachment and reclamation along the shore is gradually choking the lake, threatening fields with drought.

sentences.zh: 已開墾成熟者，免其清出，不許再侵占。

translations.literal: Those already opened for cultivation and brought to maturity are exempted from being cleared out, and further encroachment is not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Land already brought under cultivation may remain, but no further encroachment will be allowed.

sentences.zh: 」廷璋因奏：「此類田地多礙水道，請概令開濬歸湖。

translations.literal: " Tingzhang thereupon memorialized: "Such fields for the most part obstruct the watercourse; please order them all dredged and restored to the lake.
translations.idiomatic: " In reply Tingzhang memorialized: "Most of this land blocks the water channels and should all be dredged back into the lake.

sentences.zh: 沿岸栽柳，俾根株盤結，亦可固堤。

translations.literal: Willows should be planted along the shore so that their roots may intertwine and also reinforce the embankment.
translations.idiomatic: Plant willows along the banks—their interwoven roots will help stabilize the dikes.

sentences.zh: 」又請帑疏濬湖州七十二漊，洩水入太湖，免田地被淹。

translations.literal: " He also requested treasury funds to dredge the seventy-two lou of Huzhou, discharging water into Lake Tai so that fields might be spared flooding.
translations.idiomatic: " He also asked for state funds to dredge Huzhou's seventy-two lou channels and channel overflow into Lake Tai, protecting farmland from inundation.

sentences.zh: 又奏：「仁和、錢塘、蕭山三縣江塘視海塘例，以二十丈為準，按段編號立石。

translations.literal: He also memorialized: "The river dikes of the three counties Renhe, Qiantang, and Xiaoshan should follow the precedent for sea dikes, taking twenty zhang as the standard and erecting numbered marker stones section by section.
translations.idiomatic: He further proposed that river embankments in Renhe, Qiantang, and Xiaoshan counties follow sea-dike standards—twenty zhang as the benchmark, with numbered stone markers set at each section.

sentences.zh: 仁、錢二縣江塘民房，堤岸外餘二十餘裡，視海塘例，每裡設堡夫一，建堡分防。

translations.literal: For the river-dike dwellings of Renhe and Qiantang counties, beyond the outer embankment for more than twenty li, following the sea-dike precedent one fort soldier should be posted per li, with forts built for separate defense.
translations.idiomatic: Along more than twenty li of riverside dwellings beyond the Renhe and Qiantang dikes, he proposed sea-dike-style fort stations—one garrison soldier per li, with forts built for sectional defense.

sentences.zh: 」均從之。

translations.literal: " All were approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The court approved all these proposals.

sentences.zh: 又請開台州黃岩場沿海地，近場歸灶，近縣歸民。

translations.literal: He also requested opening the coastal lands of Huangyan salt field in Taizhou; those near the field were assigned to the salterns, those near the counties to the people.
translations.idiomatic: He also sought to open coastal land at Taizhou's Huangyan saltern: parcels near the field would go to the salterns, those nearer the counties to private cultivators.

sentences.zh: 戶以百畝為率，分限起科，得腴產十萬畝。

translations.literal: Households were assessed at a rate of one hundred mu, with taxation phased in by stages, yielding fertile land of one hundred thousand mu.
translations.idiomatic: Taxation was to be introduced in stages at one hundred mu per household, opening up one hundred thousand mu of rich land.

sentences.zh: 奏入，嘉許。

translations.literal: When the memorial was submitted, it was commended.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was submitted and approved with praise.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，授閩浙總督。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year he was appointed governor-general of Fujian and Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year he became governor-general of Fujian-Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 請改設螺洲、大頭崎、烏龍江諸地塘汛。

translations.literal: He requested reorganizing the tidal-garrison posts at Luozhou, Datouqi, Wulongjiang, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: He asked to reorganize garrison posts at Luozhou, Datouqi, Wulongjiang, and other sites.

sentences.zh: 又奏內地商舶出洋，覈給船照。

translations.literal: He also memorialized that merchant vessels from the interior going to sea should be verified and issued boat permits.
translations.idiomatic: He also proposed that merchant ships leaving the coast receive verified sailing permits.

sentences.zh: 又奏台灣穀賤，內地歉收，民每偷渡就食。

translations.literal: He also memorialized that grain was cheap in Taiwan while the interior had poor harvests, and the people often secretly crossed over to seek food.
translations.idiomatic: He reported that while Taiwan had cheap grain the mainland had suffered poor harvests, leading people to cross illegally in search of food.

sentences.zh: 請酌寬米禁，往來台、廈橫洋船準運米二百石，塘船六十石。

translations.literal: He requested appropriate relaxation of the rice embargo; cross-sea vessels traveling between Taiwan and Xiamen were permitted to transport two hundred shi of rice, coastal vessels sixty shi.
translations.idiomatic: He asked for a measured easing of rice restrictions: ocean-going vessels between Taiwan and Xiamen might carry two hundred shi, coastal craft sixty shi.

sentences.zh: 自鹿耳門出至廈門入，皆給照察驗。

translations.literal: From departure at Luermen to entry at Xiamen, permits were to be issued and inspections conducted.
translations.idiomatic: Ships leaving Luermen and entering Xiamen would all receive permits and be inspected.

sentences.zh: 台灣與生番接壤，前總督楊應琚飭屬勘界，挑溝築土牛以杜私墾。

translations.literal: Taiwan bordered the raw tribes; the former governor-general Yang Yingju ordered subordinates to survey the boundary, digging ditches and building earthen barriers to stop illicit reclamation.
translations.idiomatic: Taiwan bordered unsubjugated aboriginal territory; former governor-general Yang Yingju had ordered a boundary survey with ditches and earthen barriers to halt illegal land reclamation.

sentences.zh: 至是，廷璋議彰化、淡水與生番接壤，依山傍溪，挑溝築土牛為界；

translations.literal: At this time Tingzhang proposed that where Zhanghua and Danshui bordered the raw tribes, following mountains and relying on streams, ditches should be dug and earthen barriers built as the boundary;
translations.idiomatic: Now Tingzhang proposed marking Zhanghua and Danshui boundaries with aboriginal lands by digging ditches and erecting earthen barriers along mountain streams;

sentences.zh: 並於沿邊設隘寮，分兵駐守。

translations.literal: and also establishing barrier posts along the border with troops garrisoned in sections.
translations.idiomatic: and establishing border guard posts with troops stationed at intervals.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，同福建巡撫吳士功奏劾提督馬龍圖借用公使錢，並以龍圖已歸款，請用自首例減等。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, together with Fujian provincial governor Wu Shigong, he memorialized impeaching Regional Commander Ma Longtu for borrowing envoy funds, and because Longtu had already made restitution, requested application of the voluntary surrender statute for reduced punishment.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year he joined Fujian governor Wu Shigong in impeaching Regional Commander Ma Longtu for misusing diplomatic funds; since Longtu had already repaid the sum, they asked that the self-confession statute apply to reduce his sentence.

sentences.zh: 上責其錯謬，下吏議奪官，士功戍巴里坤，廷璋留任。

translations.literal: The emperor rebuked them for their error; the matter was referred to officials who proposed dismissal from office; Shigong was banished to Barkul, Tingzhang retained his post.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor upbraided them for the mistake; officials recommended stripping both of rank; Wu Shigong was exiled to Barkul but Tingzhang kept his office.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，加太子太保。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year he was granted the honorary title Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year he received the honorific Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 旋授體仁閣大學士，留總督任。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter he was appointed Grand Secretary of the Hall of Preserving Harmony, retaining his governor-general duties.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after he was made a Grand Secretary of the Hall of Preserving Harmony while remaining in his governorship.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，廷璋入覲。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year Tingzhang came to court for an audience.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year Tingzhang traveled to the capital for an audience.

sentences.zh: 福建水師提督黃仕簡奏廈門商舶出入，官署受陋規。

translations.literal: Fujian naval commander Huang Shijian memorialized that when merchant vessels entered and left Xiamen, the official offices accepted illicit customary fees.
translations.idiomatic: Fujian naval commander Huang Shijian reported that Xiamen officials were taking illicit customary fees from merchant ships entering and leaving port.

sentences.zh: 上命尚書舒赫德、待郎裘曰修往按。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Minister Shu Hede and Vice Minister Qiu Yixiu to go investigate.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor dispatched Minister Shu Hede and Vice Minister Qiu Yixiu to investigate.

sentences.zh: 具得廷璋令歷任廈門同知代市人葠、珊瑚、珍珠未發價狀，命解任。

translations.literal: They fully established that Tingzhang had ordered successive Xiamen sub-prefects to purchase on behalf of merchants ginseng, coral, and pearls for which payment had not been issued, and he was ordered relieved of office.
translations.idiomatic: The investigation found that Tingzhang had had successive Xiamen sub-prefects buy ginseng, coral, and pearls for local merchants without paying for them; he was ordered to step down.

sentences.zh: 下吏議奪官，上以廷璋平時尚能任事，授散秩大臣。

translations.literal: The matter was referred to officials who proposed dismissal from office; the emperor, considering that Tingzhang in ordinary times could still handle affairs, appointed him a minister without specific rank.
translations.idiomatic: Officials recommended stripping him of rank, but the emperor, noting Tingzhang had generally performed competently, appointed him a minister-at-large without portfolio.

sentences.zh: 未幾，授正紅旗漢軍都統、工部尚書。

translations.literal: Before long he was appointed banner commander of the Plain Red Han military banner and Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was made banner commander of the Plain Red Han military banner and Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 三十年，命署兩廣總督。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year he was ordered to serve as acting governor-general of Guangdong and Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year he was named acting governor-general of the Two Guangs.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，安南捕盜，竄入小鎮安土司怕懷隘，官兵捕得。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year Annam pursued bandits who fled into the native chieftain district Xiaozhen'an at the Pahuai pass; government troops captured them.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-first year, pursuing bandits, Annam drove them into the Xiaozhen'an native chieftain territory at Pahuai Pass, where Qing troops captured them.

sentences.zh: 廷璋照會安南遣頭人視行誅。

translations.literal: Tingzhang notified Annam and dispatched a headman to witness the execution.
translations.idiomatic: Tingzhang notified Annam and sent a local headman to witness the execution.

sentences.zh: 安南复報其國隘口盜發，請遣兵堵截。

translations.literal: Annam again reported that bandits had risen at a pass in their country and requested troops be sent to block them.
translations.idiomatic: Annam reported further bandit activity at a border pass and asked that troops be sent to cut them off.

sentences.zh: 廷璋遣兵守隘。

translations.literal: Tingzhang dispatched troops to guard the pass.
translations.idiomatic: Tingzhang sent troops to hold the pass.

sentences.zh: 事上聞，具言防邊宜鎮靜。

translations.literal: When the matter was reported to the throne, he fully stated that frontier defense ought to be calm and steady.
translations.idiomatic: Reporting to the throne, he argued that border defense called for restraint and calm.

sentences.zh: 上戒以「邊地夷情，當審度事理，因時制宜。

translations.literal: The emperor admonished him, saying: "On the frontier barbarian sentiments must be weighed by examining circumstances and adapting measures to the times.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor cautioned him: "At the border you must read barbarian temperaments carefully, weigh each case on its merits, and adapt policy to circumstances.

sentences.zh: 若專務持重，養癰貽害，弊不可勝言也。

translations.literal: If one is exclusively devoted to caution, nursing an abscess and bequeathing harm, the evils cannot be fully described.
translations.idiomatic: Excessive caution alone will let sores fester until the damage is incalculable.

sentences.zh: 」夏，崖州安岐黎為亂，擾客民，廷璋檄鎮道捕治。

translations.literal: " In summer the Anqi Li of Yazhou rebelled and harassed settler populations; Tingzhang issued orders to the regional commanders to capture and punish them.
translations.idiomatic: " That summer the Anqi Li of Yazhou rose in revolt and harassed settler communities; Tingzhang ordered the regional officials to hunt them down.

sentences.zh: 並奏：「客民編保甲，禁放債。

translations.literal: He also memorialized: "Settler populations should be organized into baojia, and lending at interest should be forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: He also proposed organizing settler communities into baojia units and banning usurious lending.

sentences.zh: 黎民市易設墟場，熟黎令薙發。

translations.literal: Li people should trade at designated market grounds; acculturated Li were ordered to shave their heads.
translations.idiomatic: Li people were to trade at designated market fairs; acculturated Li would be required to adopt the queue.

sentences.zh: 民出入黎峒必譏，以杜後患。
