translations.literal: When people entered and left Li territory they must be inspected, so as to forestall future troubles.
translations.idiomatic: All travel in and out of Li territory would be monitored to prevent future trouble.

sentences.zh: 」上從之。

translations.literal: " The emperor approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor agreed.

sentences.zh: 又奏：「小鎮安改設通判。

translations.literal: He also memorialized: "Xiaozhen'an should be reorganized with an intendant sub-prefect.
translations.idiomatic: He further proposed replacing Xiaozhen'an's administration with an intendant sub-prefect.

sentences.zh: 南界接安南，於那波、者賴、者欣三村，建卡設兵。

translations.literal: The southern border adjoins Annam; at the three villages Nabo, Zhelai, and Zhexin, checkpoint posts should be built and troops stationed.
translations.idiomatic: Along the southern border with Annam, at Nabo, Zhelai, and Zhexin villages, he proposed guard posts and garrison troops.

sentences.zh: 怕懷隘為小鎮安門戶，設兵巡緝。

translations.literal: Pahuai Pass was the gateway to Xiaozhen'an; troops should be posted to patrol and apprehend.
translations.idiomatic: At Pahuai Pass, the gateway to Xiaozhen'an, troops would patrol and intercept fugitives.

sentences.zh: 打麵樑與雲南接界，建卡防守。

translations.literal: Damianliang adjoined the Yunnan border; checkpoint posts should be built for defense.
translations.idiomatic: At Damianliang, where the border meets Yunnan, he proposed guard posts for defense.

sentences.zh: 」下部議行。

translations.literal: " The memorial was sent to the ministries for deliberation and implementation.
translations.idiomatic: " The ministries were instructed to deliberate and carry out the plan.

sentences.zh: 師徵緬甸，雲貴總督楊應琚以疾聞，上令廷璋赴永昌佐應琚治軍。

translations.literal: When the army campaigned against Burma, Yunnan-Guizhou Governor-General Yang Yingju reported illness; the emperor ordered Tingzhang to proceed to Yongchang to assist Yingju in managing the army.
translations.idiomatic: During the Burma campaign, when Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general Yang Yingju fell ill, the emperor sent Tingzhang to Yongchang to assist with military affairs.

sentences.zh: 三十二年，疏報應琚病癒，仍回廣東任。

translations.literal: In the thirty-second year he memorialized reporting that Yingju had recovered from illness and that he himself returned to his Guangdong duties.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-second year he reported Yingju's recovery and returned to his post in Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 尋召授刑部尚書。

translations.literal: Soon he was summoned and appointed Minister of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon recalled and appointed Minister of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 三十三年，授直隸總督，加太子少保。

translations.literal: In the thirty-third year he was appointed governor-general of Zhili and granted the honorary title Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-third year he became governor-general of Zhili and received the honorific Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 秋，滹沱水盛漲。

translations.literal: In autumn the Hutuo River rose to great flood.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn the Hutuo River swelled to flood stage.

sentences.zh: 廷璋請於正定西南築堤，藁城西北築埽，並以護城。

translations.literal: Tingzhang requested building dikes southwest of Zhengding, building revetments northwest of Gaocheng, also to protect the city walls.
translations.idiomatic: Tingzhang proposed dikes southwest of Zhengding and revetments northwest of Gaocheng to shield the cities.

sentences.zh: 又奏勘任丘濱淀諸地，以楊各莊諸地最低，請改種稻田；

translations.literal: He also memorialized on surveying the lands along the marshes of Renqiu; as the lands of Yanggezhuang and others were lowest, he requested converting them to rice cultivation;
translations.idiomatic: He also reported on surveying marshlands near Renqiu; since Yanggezhuang and surrounding areas were lowest, he proposed converting them to rice paddies;

sentences.zh: 文安窪修築堤埝，並於龍潭灣諸地開堤洩水，並從之。

translations.literal: At Wen'an depression dikes and embankments should be built and repaired, and at Longtanwan and other places dikes should be opened to discharge water; all were approved.
translations.idiomatic: dikes would be built at low-lying Wen'an, overflow channels opened at Longtanwan, and all these measures were approved.

sentences.zh: 三十四年，請撥通倉米十二萬運各災區平糶。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fourth year he requested allocating one hundred twenty thousand shi of grain from the Tongzhou granary to transport to various disaster areas for fair-price sale.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-fourth year he asked to draw one hundred twenty thousand shi from the Tongzhou granary for relief sale in stricken districts.

sentences.zh: 又奏：「乾隆二十四年滹沱南徙，舊河淤墊。

translations.literal: He also memorialized: "In the twenty-fourth year of Qianlong the Hutuo shifted southward, and the old channel silted up.
translations.idiomatic: He further reported: "After the Hutuo shifted south in Qianlong 24, the old riverbed silted over.

sentences.zh: 上年大漲，河行故道。

translations.literal: In the previous year during the great flood the river ran in its old course.
translations.idiomatic: Last year's flood sent the river back through its former channel.

sentences.zh: 束鹿木丘、傾井諸村遂成巨浸。

translations.literal: The villages Muqiu and Qingjing in Shulu thereby became vast inundated areas.
translations.idiomatic: Villages including Muqiu and Qingjing in Shulu were submerged under vast lakes.

sentences.zh: 請裁灣取直，並修築護城堤埝。

translations.literal: He requested cutting off bends to straighten the course, and also building and repairing protective dikes and embankments for the cities.
translations.idiomatic: He proposed cutting meanders to straighten the channel and building protective dikes around the towns.

sentences.zh: 」報聞。

translations.literal: " The report was noted.
translations.idiomatic: " The memorial was acknowledged.

sentences.zh: 三十六年，復召授刑部尚書。

translations.literal: In the thirty-sixth year he was again summoned and appointed Minister of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-sixth year he was recalled once more and made Minister of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 預香山九老會。

translations.literal: He participated in the Nine Elders gathering at Xiangshan.
translations.idiomatic: He took part in the gathering of the Nine Elders at Xiangshan.

sentences.zh: 十二月，卒，年八十四，贈太子太保，賜祭葬，諡勤愨。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month he died, aged eighty-four; he was posthumously granted Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, bestowed sacrificial and funeral honors, and given the posthumous name Qinque.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the twelfth month at eighty-four; the court posthumously honored him as Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, granted state funeral rites, and bestowed the posthumous name Qinque.

sentences.zh: =莊有恭=莊有恭，字容可，廣東番禺人。

translations.literal: Zhuang Yougong, style name Rongke, was a native of Panyu, Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuang Yougong, whose style was Rongke, came from Panyu in Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 乾隆四年一甲一名進士，授修撰，直上書房。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Qianlong he placed first in the first rank of jinshi and was appointed compiler, entering directly the Imperial Library.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 4 he took first place among jinshi graduates and was made a compiler, entering the Imperial Library directly.

sentences.zh: 後三年，弟有信成進士，引見，有恭以起居注侍直，上問及之，有信選庶吉士。

translations.literal: Three years later his younger brother Youxin passed the jinshi examination and was presented at audience; Yougong was attending duty as diarist of the emperor's movements, the emperor inquired about him, and Youxin was selected as a Hanlin bachelor.
translations.idiomatic: Three years later his brother Youxin passed the jinshi examination; when Youxin was presented at court, Yougong was on duty as imperial diarist, the emperor asked after him, and Youxin was selected for the Hanlin Academy.

sentences.zh: 兄弟同請告省親。

translations.literal: The two brothers together requested leave to visit their parents.
translations.idiomatic: Both brothers requested leave together to visit their parents.

sentences.zh: 有恭累遷侍講學士，擢光祿寺卿。

translations.literal: Yougong was repeatedly promoted to expositor-in-waiting, then elevated to director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments.
translations.idiomatic: Yougong rose through the ranks to expositor-in-waiting and then director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments.

sentences.zh: 以父憂歸，服除，擢內閣學士。

translations.literal: He returned home on father's bereavement; when mourning ended he was promoted to Grand Secretary of the Grand Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: He went into mourning for his father's death; when the mourning period ended he was promoted to Grand Secretariat academician.

sentences.zh: 遷戶部侍郎。

translations.literal: He was transferred to vice minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: He moved to the post of vice minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 督江蘇學政。

translations.literal: He served as Jiangsu provincial educational commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed educational commissioner of Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 充江南鄉試考官，复督江蘇學政。

translations.literal: He served as examiner for the Jiangnan provincial examination, then again supervised as Jiangsu educational commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He served as chief examiner for the Jiangnan provincial exams, then resumed duties as Jiangsu educational commissioner.

sentences.zh: 十六年，授江蘇巡撫。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he was appointed Jiangsu provincial governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year he became Jiangsu provincial governor.

sentences.zh: 十七年，署兩江總督。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year he served as acting governor-general of the Two Jiangs.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year he was named acting governor-general of the Two Jiangs.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「太倉、鎮洋沿海田廬，賴海塘保障。

translations.literal: He memorialized, stating: "The coastal fields and dwellings of Taicang and Zhenyang rely on sea dikes for protection.
translations.idiomatic: He reported: "Coastal fields and homes in Taicang and Zhenyang depend on sea dikes for protection.

sentences.zh: 前巡撫高其倬議自寶山湖口港至昭文福山港築土塘三萬四千七百餘丈，僅築湖口港至劉河南岸土、石塘。

translations.literal: Former provincial governor Gao Qiong proposed building earthen dikes of more than thirty-four thousand seven hundred zhang from Baoshan Hukou Harbor to Zhaowen Fushan Harbor, but only the earthen and stone dikes from Hukou Harbor to the south bank of the Liu River were built.
translations.idiomatic: Former governor Gao Qiong had proposed thirty-four thousand seven hundred-odd zhang of earthen dikes from Baoshan Hukou Harbor to Zhaowen Fushan Harbor, but only the section from Hukou Harbor to the south bank of the Liu River had been completed in earth and stone.

sentences.zh: 今年秋令風潮，劉河南賴以無恙。

translations.literal: This year in the autumn season during wind and tide, the area south of the Liu River relied on this and was unharmed.
translations.idiomatic: This autumn's storms left the south bank of the Liu River unscathed thanks to that work.

sentences.zh: 其北頗致損傷，士民自請挑築。

translations.literal: To the north considerable damage was caused; gentry and commoners themselves requested dredging and building.
translations.idiomatic: The northern section suffered considerable damage, and local gentry and commoners volunteered to repair it.

sentences.zh: 惟恐一時難集，工不速竟。

translations.literal: He only feared that labor could not be gathered at once and the work would not be quickly completed.
translations.idiomatic: He worried they could not muster enough labor quickly and the work would not finish in time.

sentences.zh: 應築土塘九千丈有奇，請借庫銀一萬六千兩，令自募夫役，於伏汛前畢工。

translations.literal: Earthen dikes of more than nine thousand zhang should be built; he requested borrowing sixteen thousand taels from the treasury, ordering them to recruit laborers themselves, to finish before the summer low-water season.
translations.idiomatic: Nine thousand-odd zhang of earthen dike remained to be built; he asked to borrow sixteen thousand taels from the treasury for local labor recruitment, with completion before the summer low-water season.

sentences.zh: 按畝扣輸，二年清款。

translations.literal: Deductions per mu would be collected, with accounts settled in two years.
translations.idiomatic: Costs would be recovered through per-mu assessments over two years.

sentences.zh: 」如所請行。

translations.literal: " As requested, it was carried out.
translations.idiomatic: " The court approved as he had proposed.

sentences.zh: 有恭督學政時，浙人丁文彬獻所著文武記、太公望傳等。

translations.literal: When Yougong was supervising education, the Zhejiang native Ding Wenbin presented his own works Military and Civil Records, Biography of Taigong Wang, and others.
translations.idiomatic: While serving as educational commissioner, a Zhejiang scholar named Ding Wenbin submitted his own works, including Military and Civil Records and Biography of Taigong Wang.

sentences.zh: 有恭以為病狂，置不問。

translations.literal: Yougong regarded him as deranged and set the matter aside without inquiry.
translations.idiomatic: Yougong dismissed him as mad and ignored the submission.

sentences.zh: 至是，文彬以書上衍聖公孔昭煥，昭煥告巡撫楊應琚以聞。

translations.literal: At this time Wenbin sent his book to the Duke Yansheng Kong Zhaohuan; Zhaohuan informed Provincial Governor Yang Yingju, who reported it upward.
translations.idiomatic: Now Wenbin sent his book to Duke Yansheng Kong Zhaohuan, who alerted governor Yang Yingju, who reported the matter to the throne.

sentences.zh: 有恭疏請罪，坐罰學政養廉銀十倍。

translations.literal: Yougong memorialized requesting punishment; he was sentenced to a fine of ten times his educational commissioner's integrity-nurture silver.
translations.idiomatic: Yougong submitted a self-accusation and was fined ten times his educational commissioner's supplemental salary.

sentences.zh: 十九年，御史楊開鼎條奏江南收漕諸弊，敕有恭覆奏。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year Censor Yang Kaiding submitted a detailed memorial on various abuses in grain collection in Jiangnan; Yougong was ordered to reply in a memorial.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year censor Yang Kaiding memorialized item by item on grain-collection abuses in Jiangnan, and the court ordered Yougong to respond.

sentences.zh: 尋疏言：「江南收漕諸弊，以蘇、常、松、鎮、太五屬為尤甚。

translations.literal: Soon he memorialized, stating: "Among the various abuses in grain collection in Jiangnan, the five jurisdictions Suzhou, Changzhou, Songjiang, Zhenjiang, and Taicang are especially severe.
translations.idiomatic: He soon reported: "Of grain-collection abuses in Jiangnan, those in Suzhou, Changzhou, Songjiang, Zhenjiang, and Taicang are worst.

sentences.zh: 已酌定條例，勒石漕倉，遇收漕，飭糧道以下官週巡察訪。

translations.literal: Regulations have already been drafted, carved in stone at the grain-transport warehouses; when grain is collected, officials from the grain commissioner downward are ordered to make circuit inspections.
translations.idiomatic: He had drafted regulations engraved at grain warehouses, requiring the grain intendant and subordinates to conduct regular inspections during collection.

sentences.zh: 開鼎言需索不遂，藉詞米不如式，勒令曬晾篩颺。

translations.literal: Kaiding stated that when demands were not satisfied they took pretext that the grain did not meet specification and forced drying, airing, and winnowing.
translations.idiomatic: Kaiding had reported that when bribes were refused, collectors claimed grain failed to meet standards and forced farmers to dry and winnow it repeatedly.

sentences.zh: 漕糧上供天庾，自應乾圓潔淨。

translations.literal: Transport grain supplied to the celestial granary naturally ought to be dry, round, clean, and pure.
translations.idiomatic: Tribute grain for the imperial granaries should naturally be dry, clean, and well formed.

sentences.zh: 儻不如式，不堪久貯，必致貽誤倉儲。

translations.literal: If by chance not according to specification, it cannot bear long storage, and will necessarily cause harm to granary reserves.
translations.idiomatic: Grain that fails to meet standards cannot be stored for long and will inevitably compromise the granaries.

sentences.zh: 糧戶良頑不等，每次青腰、白臍、潮嫩、雜碎諸米強交；

translations.literal: Grain households vary in good and obstinate quality; each time green-waist, white-belly, damp-tender, mixed-broken, and other rice are forcibly delivered;
translations.idiomatic: Delivering households differ widely in compliance, yet each year they force submission of greenish, cracked, damp, and broken rice mixed together;

sentences.zh: 如令更易，即造作浮言挾制。

translations.literal: If ordered to exchange them, they immediately manufacture floating words to coerce.
translations.idiomatic: and if officials demand replacement, they spread rumors to intimidate them.

sentences.zh: 自應分別察究，不得但責官吏，取悅刁民。

translations.literal: Naturally one should investigate separately and in detail; one must not merely blame officials to please obstinate commoners.
translations.idiomatic: The matter should be examined case by case, not resolved by blaming officials simply to appease troublemakers.

sentences.zh: 」上獎其言公正。

translations.literal: " The emperor praised his words as fair and just.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor commended his reply as impartial.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，丁母憂，命予假百日回籍治喪，於伏汛前至淮安，署江南河道總督。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year, upon mourning for his mother, he was granted leave of one hundred days to return home to manage funeral affairs; before the summer flood season he reached Huai'an and served as acting governor-general of Jiangnan River Conservancy.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year, while mourning his mother, he was granted a hundred days' leave to return home for the funeral; he reached Huai'an before the summer flood season and took up acting duties as governor-general of Jiangnan River Conservancy.

sentences.zh: 泰興縣有硃者，坐主使殺人罪至絞，乞贖罪，有恭許之，臨行疏聞。

translations.literal: In Taixing County there was one Zhu who, convicted of instigating murder with the penalty reaching strangulation, begged to redeem the offense; Yougong permitted it and reported by memorial as he was about to depart.
translations.idiomatic: In Taixing County a man surnamed Zhu had been sentenced to death by strangulation for instigating murder; he petitioned to redeem his offense, and Yougong granted it, reporting the matter in a memorial as he was leaving office.

sentences.zh: 上責其專擅，令家居待罪。

translations.literal: The emperor rebuked him for acting on his own authority and ordered him to remain at home awaiting punishment.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor censured him for overstepping his authority and ordered him to remain at home pending judgment.

sentences.zh: 總督尹繼善又言有恭監臨鄉試，察出有賄謀聯號者，復有以鬥蟋蟀致訟者，皆令罰鍰，未奏聞。

translations.literal: Governor-General Yin Jishan also reported that when Yougong supervised the provincial examination, he discovered those who had bribed to collude in examination numbers, and also cases of litigation arising from cricket fighting—all were ordered to pay fines without having been reported to the throne.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Yin Jishan further reported that while supervising the provincial exams, Yougong had uncovered candidates who bribed to coordinate examination numbers, as well as lawsuits arising from cricket fights—all punished with fines, none of which had been reported to the throne.

sentences.zh: 上命奪有恭官，逮詣京師，下大學士九卿論罪，當絞。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Yougong stripped of office, arrested and sent to the capital, and submitted to the grand secretaries and ministers of the Nine Chief Offices for judgment of offense—the penalty fixed was strangulation.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor stripped Yougong of office, had him brought to the capital, and referred the case to the grand secretaries and Nine Chief Offices, who fixed the penalty as death by strangulation.

sentences.zh: 上以贓不入己，貰之，令護母喪回籍後赴軍台效力。

translations.literal: The emperor, because the bribes had not entered his own possession, pardoned him and ordered that after escorting his mother's funeral he return home, then proceed to serve at a military outpost.
translations.idiomatic: Because the bribes had not enriched him personally, the emperor commuted the sentence and ordered him to complete his mother's funeral at home before reporting to a military outpost for penal service.

sentences.zh: 方詣謫所，命戴罪署湖北巡撫。

translations.literal: Just as he was proceeding to his place of exile, he was ordered to serve while bearing guilt as acting governor of Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: While he was still on his way to exile, he was appointed acting governor of Hubei, permitted to serve despite his guilt.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，調浙江。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year, he was transferred to Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year he was transferred to Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，劾杭州將軍伊領阿、副都統劉揚達違例乘轎。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year, he impeached Hangzhou General Yiling'a and Vice Commander-in-chief Liu Yangda for violating regulations by riding in sedan chairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year he impeached Hangzhou general Yiling'a and vice commander Liu Yangda for riding in sedan chairs in violation of regulations.

sentences.zh: 上奪伊領阿等官，獎有恭，命議敘。

translations.literal: The emperor stripped Yiling'a and others of office, praised Yougong, and ordered evaluation for reward.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor dismissed Yiling'a and the others, praised Yougong, and ordered him considered for honors.

sentences.zh: 三月，疏言：「紹興南塘、嘉興乍浦塘並屬要工。

translations.literal: In the third month he memorialized, stating: "The southern dike at Shaoxing and the Zhapu dike at Jiaxing both belong to critical works.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month he reported: "The southern dike at Shaoxing and the Zhapu dike at Jiaxing are both critical projects.

sentences.zh: 臣赴山陰勘得宋家樓為三江、曹娥二水交會，又適當潮汐之衝，為南塘首險，已改建石塘鞏固。

translations.literal: Your subject went to Shanyin and inspected, finding Songjialou to be where the Three Rivers and Cao'e River meet, and also directly at the impact of tides—it is the foremost danger point of the southern dike; a stone dike has already been rebuilt to fortify it.
translations.idiomatic: I inspected Shanyin and found that Songjialou lies where the Three Rivers and the Cao'e meet and directly in the path of the tides—it is the most dangerous point on the southern dike, and I have rebuilt it as a stone embankment to strengthen it.

sentences.zh: 復至蕭山龕、長等山，越南大亹至海寧中小亹、登文堂、葛嶴諸山，勘海寧南門外，西過戴家石橋，東至陳文港，工長五千丈有奇，根址堅實，不須重建。

translations.literal: Again he went to K'an, Chang, and other mountains in Xiaoshan, crossing south from Da Wei to Xiaowei, Dengwentang, Ge'ao, and other mountains in Haining; he inspected outside Haining's south gate, west past Daijia Stone Bridge, east to Chenwengang—the work length exceeds five thousand zhang, the foundation solid, and no rebuilding is needed.
translations.idiomatic: I also surveyed K'an, Chang, and other hills in Xiaoshan, proceeding south from Da Wei through Xiaowei, Dengwentang, Ge'ao, and other heights in Haining; outside Haining's south gate, from Daijia Stone Bridge west to Chenwengang east, the dike runs more than five thousand zhang with foundations still solid enough that rebuilding is unnecessary.

sentences.zh: 其必當修築者千六百餘丈，內七百七十餘丈殘缺過甚，作為要工，餘次第興修。

translations.literal: Of those that must be repaired and built, more than sixteen hundred zhang; within this, more than seven hundred seventy zhang are excessively damaged and deficient—these are treated as critical works, the remainder to be built in sequence.
translations.idiomatic: About sixteen hundred zhang must be repaired; of these, more than seven hundred seventy zhang are so badly damaged as to count as urgent work, with the rest to be rebuilt in order.

sentences.zh: 自陳文港東至尖山，下有韓家池柴塘四百丈有奇，亦應重築。

translations.literal: From Chenwengang east to Jianshan, below there is Hanjiachi firewood dike of more than four hundred zhang—it too should be heavily rebuilt.
translations.idiomatic: From Chenwengang east to Jianshan, the Hanjiachi reed dike of more than four hundred zhang below also requires major rebuilding.

sentences.zh: 复循海而北，自海鹽至平湖，遍歷乍浦塘。

translations.literal: Again following the sea northward, from Haiyan to Pinghu, he traversed all of the Zhapu dike.
translations.idiomatic: He then followed the coast north from Haiyan to Pinghu, surveying the entire Zhapu dike.

sentences.zh: 海鹽東臨​​大海，南有台駐，北有乍浦諸山，山趾角張。

translations.literal: Haiyan faces the great sea to the east, has Taizhu to the south, and Zhapu and other mountains to the north—the mountain footings spread out like horns.
translations.idiomatic: Haiyan looks out on the open sea to the east, with Taizhu to the south and the Zhapu hills to the north, their foothills spreading outward like horns.

sentences.zh: 縣城以一面當潮汐，城外石塘，最為險要，間有衝損，已令隨時修補。

translations.literal: The county seat has one side facing tides; the stone dike outside the city is most critical and dangerous—where there is occasional damage from impact, orders have already been given to repair at any time.
translations.idiomatic: The county seat faces the tides on one side; the stone dike outside the walls is the most critical stretch, and where storm damage occurs I have ordered repairs as needed.

sentences.zh: 」六月，又疏言：「西塘、胡家兜至海寧南門外，潮退沙漲，長十八里。

translations.literal: " In the sixth month he again memorialized, stating: "From Xitang and Hujiadou to outside Haining's south gate, when the tide recedes sand accumulates, extending eighteen li.
translations.idiomatic: " In the sixth month he reported again: "From Xitang and Hujiadou to outside Haining's south gate, sand has built up over eighteen li as the tide recedes.

sentences.zh: 前請辦戴家石橋要工，既有新沙外護，應先就迤東工段趲辦。

translations.literal: Previously requested to handle the critical work at Daijia Stone Bridge; now that new sand provides outer protection, priority should first be given to pressing forward the work sections extending east.
translations.idiomatic: The urgent work at Daijia Stone Bridge that I requested earlier is now shielded by new sandbanks, so the eastern sections should be pushed forward first.

sentences.zh: 再審量沙勢，分別緩急。

translations.literal: Then re-examine and measure the sand conditions, distinguishing urgency and delay.
translations.idiomatic: Once the sand conditions are reassessed, work can be prioritized accordingly.

sentences.zh: 」九月，又疏言：「緩修各工，陳文港十丈，令用魚鱗式逐層整砌。

translations.literal: " In the ninth month he again memorialized, stating: "For the various works under deferred repair, at Chenwengang ten zhang, order use of fish-scale pattern, layer by layer neatly laid.
translations.idiomatic: " In the ninth month he reported again: "For deferred repairs, the ten zhang at Chenwengang should be rebuilt in fish-scale masonry, course by course.

sentences.zh: 圓通菴前十丈，仍如式堅築。

translations.literal: The ten zhang before Yuantong Nunnery should still be solidly built according to specification.
translations.idiomatic: The ten zhang before Yuantong Nunnery should likewise be solidly built to standard.

sentences.zh: 廿里亭西二十五丈，修整坦面，加用排椿，令緊貼塘身。

translations.literal: Twenty-five zhang west of Nianli Pavilion—repair the slope face, add rows of piles, and order them tightly pressed against the dike body.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-five zhang west of Nianli Pavilion requires slope repair and additional rows of piles set flush against the dike.

sentences.zh: 」二十六年十二月，又奏言：「海寧西塘、老鹽倉諸地，經黴、伏兩汛，老沙汕刷，宜先事預防，先後拆鑲二百丈。

translations.literal: " In the twelfth month of the twenty-sixth year he again memorialized, stating: "At Xitang, Laoyancang, and other places in Haining, having passed through the plum-rain and summer flood seasons, old sand banks were scoured away; preventive measures should be taken beforehand—two hundred zhang were dismantled and inlaid in succession.
translations.idiomatic: " In the twelfth month of the twenty-sixth year he reported again: "At Haining's Xitang, Laoyancang, and nearby stretches, the plum-rain and summer floods had scoured away old sandbanks; to guard against this, two hundred zhang were dismantled and rebuilt in stages.

sentences.zh: 自霜降後，臣往來察勘，見柴、石兩塘交接處水已臨塘，自此迤西，老沙仍多坍卸。

translations.literal: After Frost Descent, your subject went back and forth inspecting and found that at the junction of the firewood and stone dikes water already pressed against the dike; from there westward, old sand still suffered much collapse and sloughing.
translations.idiomatic: Since Frost Descent I have inspected repeatedly and found water already lapping the junction of the reed and stone dikes; westward from there, old sandbanks continue to collapse.

sentences.zh: 請將接連前工七十丈，從速鑲辦。

translations.literal: He requested that the seventy zhang connecting to the previous work be quickly inlaid and completed.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that the seventy zhang adjoining the earlier work be rebuilt without delay.

sentences.zh: 」均從之。

translations.literal: " All were approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The court approved all of it.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，上南巡，臨視老鹽倉、尖山諸地，令修築柴塘，並設竹簍、坦水諸工。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year the emperor made a southern tour, personally inspected Laoyancang, Jianshan, and other places, and ordered repair and building of firewood dikes, and also establishment of bamboo-basket and slope-apron works.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year, on his southern tour, the emperor inspected Laoyancang, Jianshan, and nearby sites, ordering reed-dike repairs and the installation of bamboo revetments and slope works.

sentences.zh: 九月，疏報海寧塘工竟，上嘉有恭能盡心，命議敘。

translations.literal: In the ninth month he memorialized reporting that the Haining dike works were completed; the emperor praised Yougong for devoting himself fully and ordered evaluation for reward.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month he reported the Haining dike project complete; the emperor praised Yougong's dedication and ordered him considered for honors.

sentences.zh: 是秋多雨水漲，有恭以嘉、湖兩府水歸太湖，河道多淤，下流尤壅閼；

translations.literal: That autumn there was much rain and rising water; Yougong held that the waters of Jiaxing and Huzhou two prefectures drain into Lake Tai, the river channels are much silted, and the lower reaches are especially blocked and obstructed;
translations.idiomatic: That autumn brought heavy rains and flooding; Yougong observed that waters from Jiaxing and Huzhou drain into Lake Tai, that channels were heavily silted, and that the lower reaches were especially choked;

sentences.zh: 因請浚烏程、長興境內七十二漊，並遣吏至江南按行三江故道。

translations.literal: Therefore he requested dredging the seventy-two creeks within the boundaries of Wucheng and Changxing, and also dispatched officials to Jiangnan to inspect and traverse the old courses of the Three Rivers.
translations.idiomatic: he therefore requested dredging of the seventy-two creeks in Wucheng and Changxing and sent officials to Jiangnan to survey the old courses of the Three Rivers.

sentences.zh: 十月，調江蘇巡撫。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, he was transferred to Jiangsu provincial governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month he was transferred to governor of Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 上命浙江海塘工程仍責成有恭專司其事，並免學政任內應罰銀。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered that Zhejiang sea-dike works still be entrusted to Yougong to specialize in managing the matter, and also exempted the fine silver owed from his term as educational commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor directed that Zhejiang's sea-dike work remain Yougong's responsibility and waived the fine owed from his term as educational commissioner.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，擢刑部尚書，留巡撫任。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year, he was promoted to minister of Justice but retained his governorship duties.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year he was promoted to minister of Justice while remaining in his governorship.

sentences.zh: 有恭疏請大修三江水利，略言：「太湖北受荊溪百瀆，南受天目諸山之水，為吳中巨浸，而分疏之大幹，以三江為要。

translations.literal: Yougong memorialized requesting major repairs to the Three Rivers waterworks, stating in summary: "Lake Tai to the north receives the hundred streams of Jingxi, to the south receives the waters of the Tianmu mountains—it is the great lake of central Wu, and among the main channels for dividing and draining it, the Three Rivers are essential.
translations.idiomatic: Yougong memorialized for a major overhaul of the Three Rivers waterworks, summarizing: "Lake Tai, fed north by the hundred streams of Jingxi and south by the Tianmu ranges, is the great lake of Wu; and its chief outlets for drainage are the Three Rivers.

sentences.zh: 三江者，吳淞江、婁江、東江也。

translations.literal: The Three Rivers are the Wusong River, Lou River, and Dong River.
translations.idiomatic: The Three Rivers are the Wusong, Lou, and Dong rivers.

sentences.zh: 東江自宋已湮，明永樂間，別開黃浦，寬廣足當三江之一，今亦謂之東江。

translations.literal: The Dong River had already silted up since the Song; in the Yongle reign of Ming, the Huangpu was separately opened—broad and wide enough to serve as one of the Three Rivers—and today it too is called the Dong River.
translations.idiomatic: The original Dong River had silted shut by Song times; in Ming Yongle the Huangpu was cut as a new channel, broad enough to count as one of the Three Rivers, and it too is now called the Dong River.

sentences.zh: 三江分流，經吳江、震澤、吳、元和、崑山、新陽、青浦、華亭、上海、太倉、鎮洋、嘉定十二州縣境，其間港浦縱橫，湖蕩參錯。

translations.literal: The Three Rivers divide and flow through the territories of twelve prefectures and counties—Wujiang, Zhenze, Wu, Yuanhe, Kunshan, Xinyang, Qingpu, Huating, Shanghai, Taicang, Zhenyang, and Jiading—among which harbors and creeks run crisscross, and lakes and marshes intermingle.
translations.idiomatic: The Three Rivers branch across twelve prefectures and counties—Wujiang, Zhenze, Wu, Yuanhe, Kunshan, Xinyang, Qingpu, Huating, Shanghai, Taicang, Zhenyang, and Jiading—a region laced with channels and interwoven lakes and marshes.

sentences.zh: 大概觀之，無處不可​​分洩。

translations.literal: Viewed in general, there is nowhere that cannot divide and discharge.
translations.idiomatic: Taken as a whole, water could theoretically be discharged in countless places.

sentences.zh: 然百節之通，不敵一節之塞。

translations.literal: Yet a hundred open sections cannot match one blocked section.
translations.idiomatic: Yet a hundred open passages cannot compensate for one blocked choke point.

sentences.zh: 太湖出水口，不特寶帶橋一處，如吳江十八港、十七橋，吳縣鮎魚口、大缺口，為湖水穿運河入江要道，今不無淺阻。

translations.literal: The outlets of Lake Tai are not only at Baodai Bridge alone—such as Wujiang's eighteen harbors and seventeen bridges, and Wuxian's Nianyukou and Daquekou, which are critical routes for lake water to pass through the Grand Canal into the river—today none are without shallow obstruction.
translations.idiomatic: Lake Tai has more outlets than Baodai Bridge alone—Wujiang's eighteen harbors and seventeen bridges, Wuxian's Nianyukou and Daquekou, all key paths for lake water to reach the Grand Canal and the Yangtze—and many are now shoaled or blocked.

sentences.zh: 又如入吳淞之龐山湖、大斜港、九里湖、淀山湖、溆浦，向來寬深，近以小民貪利，遍植茭蘆，圈築魚盪，亦多侵占。

translations.literal: Again such as Pangshan Lake, Daxiegang, Jiuli Lake, Dianshan Lake, and Xupu entering the Wusong—formerly broad and deep—recently common people, greedy for profit, have everywhere planted water caltrop and reeds, encircled and built fish ponds, and also greatly encroached.
translations.idiomatic: Likewise Pangshan Lake, Daxiegang, Jiuli Lake, Dianshan Lake, and Xupu, which feed the Wusong and were once broad and deep, have been narrowed as locals plant reeds and water caltrop for profit, ring off fish ponds, and encroach on the channels.

sentences.zh: 劉河，古婁江也。

translations.literal: The Liu River is the ancient Lou River.
translations.idiomatic: The Liu River is the old Lou River channel.

sentences.zh: 今河形大非昔比，舟楫來往，必艤舟待潮。

translations.literal: Today the river's form is greatly unlike the past; boats coming and going must moor and wait for the tide.
translations.idiomatic: Today it is nothing like its former self; boats must anchor and wait for the tide.

sentences.zh: 崑山外濠為婁江正道，淺狹特甚。

translations.literal: Kunshan's outer moat is the main course of the Lou River—it is especially shallow and narrow.
translations.idiomatic: Kunshan's outer moat, the main Lou River channel, is especially shallow and narrow.

sentences.zh: 蘇州婁門外江面僅寬四五丈，偶遇秋霖，眾水匯集。

translations.literal: Outside Suzhou's Lou Gate the river surface is only four or five zhang wide; when autumn rains happen by chance, many waters gather together.
translations.idiomatic: Outside Suzhou's Lou Gate the channel is only four or five zhang wide; in an autumn downpour, waters converge there at once.

sentences.zh: 江身淺窄，先為潦水所佔，俟其稍退，然後湖水得出，為之傳送，而上游已漫淹矣。

translations.literal: The river body is shallow and narrow—first occupied by floodwater; only after it recedes slightly can lake water then emerge and be conveyed through, yet the upper reaches are already inundated.
translations.idiomatic: The channel is so shallow and narrow that floodwaters fill it first; only after they subside can lake water pass through, by which time the upper country is already flooded.

sentences.zh: 東南財賦重地，水利民生大計，若及早為之，事半功倍。

translations.literal: The southeast is a region heavy with fiscal revenue; waterworks are a great plan for people's livelihood—if done early, half the effort yields double the result.
translations.idiomatic: In this revenue-rich southeast, water control is vital to people's livelihoods; acting early would achieve twice the result for half the effort.

sentences.zh: 今籌治法，當於運河西凡太湖出水之口，皆為清釐佔塞，俾分流無阻。

translations.literal: Now in planning the method of governance, west of the Grand Canal at every outlet of Lake Tai, all encroachments and blockages should be cleared so that divided flow meets no obstruction.
translations.idiomatic: My plan is to clear every Lake Tai outlet west of the Grand Canal of encroachment and blockage so that divided flows run freely.

sentences.zh: 其運河東三江故道，惟黃浦現在深通，但於泖口挑去新漲蘆墩，足資宣洩。

translations.literal: East of the Grand Canal among the old courses of the Three Rivers, only the Huangpu is now deep and open; but at the Mao mouth, dredging away newly risen reed mounds would suffice to provide discharge.
translations.idiomatic: East of the canal, of the Three Rivers' old courses only the Huangpu remains deep and open; dredging the new reed shoals at its mouth would be enough to improve discharge.

sentences.zh: 吳淞江自龐山湖以下，婁江自婁門以下，凡有淺狹阻滯之處，宜濬治寬深，令上流所洩之數，足相容納。

translations.literal: From Pangshan Lake downward on the Wusong River, and from Lou Gate downward on the Lou River—wherever there are shallow, narrow, obstructed places, dredging to widen and deepen is appropriate, so that the volume discharged from the upper reaches can be fully contained.
translations.idiomatic: From Pangshan Lake downstream on the Wusong, and from Lou Gate downstream on the Lou, every shallow or choked stretch should be dredged wide and deep enough to carry the full volume from upstream.

sentences.zh: 其江身所有植蘆插籪及冒占之區，盡數剷除，嗣後仍嚴為之禁。

translations.literal: All areas within the river body where reeds are planted, weirs inserted, or encroachments made should be entirely uprooted and removed; afterward strict prohibition should still be enforced.
translations.idiomatic: Reed beds, brush weirs, and illegal encroachments within the channels should all be cleared, with strict prohibition thereafter.

sentences.zh: 則水之停蓄有所，傳送以時，並即以挑河之土加培圩岸。

translations.literal: Then water will have places to hold and store, be conveyed in season, and the earth from dredging the rivers can at the same time be used to heighten and strengthen the dike banks.
translations.idiomatic: Water would then have room to pond and pass in good time, and dredged earth could at once be used to raise the levees.

sentences.zh: 現在徬座去海太近，難於啟閉者，酌量改移，庶渾潮不入，清水盛強，而海口之淤，亦將不挑而自去。

translations.literal: Sluice structures now too close to the sea and difficult to open and close should be considered for relocation, so that muddy tides do not enter, clear water grows strong, and silt at the river mouth will also be removed without dredging.
translations.idiomatic: Sluice gates now too close to the sea to operate properly should be relocated where feasible, keeping muddy tides out, strengthening the clear-water flow, and letting the river mouth scour itself without dredging.

sentences.zh: 總計所需雖覺浩繁，然散在十二州縣，通力合作，實亦無多。

translations.literal: The total required, though it seems vast and numerous, spread across twelve prefectures and counties with combined effort and cooperation, is in fact not much.
translations.idiomatic: The total cost may seem enormous, but spread across twelve prefectures and counties working together, the burden is not so great.

sentences.zh: 民間聞有此舉，咸樂趨事，原以民力為之。

translations.literal: When the people hear of this undertaking, all gladly hurry to the work—it was originally to be done with popular labor.
translations.idiomatic: The people, hearing of the project, are eager to take part; the work was originally intended to rely on local labor.

sentences.zh: 但分段督修，仍須官董其成；

translations.literal: But for section-by-section supervision and repair, officials must still oversee completion;
translations.idiomatic: But section-by-section repairs still require official supervision;

sentences.zh: 且工費繁多，若待鳩財而後興工，稍稽時日。

translations.literal: Moreover the work expenses are numerous; if one waits to gather funds before starting work, time will be slightly delayed.
translations.idiomatic: and costs are heavy; waiting to raise funds before starting would lose valuable time.

sentences.zh: 懇發帑興工，仍於各州縣分年按畝徵還，​​則民力既紓，工可速集。

translations.literal: He earnestly requested disbursing from the treasury to start work, still collecting repayment by mu year by year in each prefecture and county—then popular labor would be relieved and work could be quickly assembled.
translations.idiomatic: I therefore ask that the treasury advance the funds, to be repaid over successive years by per-mu assessment in each county; this would ease the people's burden and allow work to begin at once.

sentences.zh: 」奏入，報可。

translations.literal: " The memorial was submitted and approval was reported.
translations.idiomatic: " The memorial was approved.

sentences.zh: 於是選紳耆，賦工役，先疏橋港，次及河身。

translations.literal: Thereupon gentry elders were selected, labor corvée was assigned, first dredging bridges and harbors, then reaching the river bodies.
translations.idiomatic: Gentry elders were chosen to organize labor, dredging bridges and harbors first and then the main channels.

sentences.zh: 茭蘆魚蕩之圈佔者，除之；

translations.literal: Encircled and occupied water-caltrop, reed, and fish-pond areas were removed;
translations.idiomatic: Illegal reed beds and fish ponds were cleared away;

sentences.zh: 城市民居之不可毀者，別開月河以導之。

translations.literal: Urban dwellings that could not be destroyed had separate crescent canals opened to channel water around them.
translations.idiomatic: where city dwellings could not be demolished, crescent canals were cut to route water around them.

sentences.zh: 工始於二十八年十二月，至二十九年三月告竟，用公帑二十二萬有奇。

translations.literal: Work began in the twelfth month of the twenty-eighth year and was reported complete by the third month of the twenty-ninth year, using more than two hundred twenty thousand taels from the public treasury.
translations.idiomatic: Work began in the twelfth month of the twenty-eighth year and was finished by the third month of the twenty-ninth, at a cost of more than two hundred twenty thousand taels from the public purse.

sentences.zh: 三十年正月，命協辦大學士，仍暫留巡撫任。

translations.literal: In the first month of the thirtieth year, he was appointed assisting grand secretary but still temporarily retained his governorship duties.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the thirtieth year he was named assisting grand secretary while temporarily remaining in his governorship.

sentences.zh: 南巡，复賜詩褒勉。

translations.literal: On the southern tour, again he was granted an imperial poem of praise and encouragement.
translations.idiomatic: On the southern tour the emperor again bestowed a poem in praise and encouragement.

sentences.zh: 八月，召詣京師。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, he was summoned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month he was summoned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 有恭劾蘇州同知段成功縱役累民，奪官，讞未定。

translations.literal: Yougong impeached Suzhou sub-prefect Duan Chenggong for allowing runners to oppress the people, stripped him of office, but the judicial decision was not yet fixed.
translations.idiomatic: Yougong had impeached Suzhou sub-prefect Duan Chenggong for letting yamen runners abuse the people, stripped him of office, but the case remained undecided.

sentences.zh: 巡撫明德察成功實受賕，詐稱病；

translations.literal: Governor Mingde investigated and found Chenggong had in fact accepted bribes and falsely claimed illness;
translations.idiomatic: Governor Mingde found that Chenggong had in fact taken bribes and feigned illness;

sentences.zh: 按察使硃奎揚、知府孔傳鶺皆知之，不以言。

translations.literal: Provincial judicial commissioner Zhu Kuiyang and prefect Kong Chuanji all knew of it but did not speak of it.
translations.idiomatic: provincial judicial commissioner Zhu Kuiyang and prefect Kong Chuanji had known but said nothing.

sentences.zh: 上命奪奎揚等官，逮訊。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Kuiyang and others stripped of office and arrested for interrogation.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor stripped Kuiyang and the others of office and had them arrested for questioning.

sentences.zh: 三十一年正月，罷有恭協辦大學士。

translations.literal: In the first month of the thirty-first year, Yougong was dismissed from assisting grand secretary.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the thirty-first year Yougong was removed from his post as assisting grand secretary.

sentences.zh: 又遣侍郎四達按治，得有恭授意奎揚等有意從寬狀，並奪有恭官，下刑部獄。

translations.literal: Again Vice Minister Sida was dispatched to investigate and govern; it was found that Yougong had instructed Kuiyang and others with intent to leniency—Yougong was also stripped of office and imprisoned in the Ministry of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Minister Sida was sent to investigate and found that Yougong had prompted Kuiyang and others to treat the case leniently; Yougong too was dismissed and imprisoned in the Ministry of Justice.

sentences.zh: 軍機大臣會鞫，並追繳學政任內應罰銀。

translations.literal: Grand councilors jointly tried the case and also pursued recovery of the fine silver owed from his term as educational commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Council jointly tried the case and also demanded repayment of the fine owed from his term as educational commissioner.

sentences.zh: 二月，軍機大臣等讞上，有恭罪應斬，諭改監候。

translations.literal: In the second month the grand councilors and others submitted the judicial decision—Yougong's offense warranted decapitation; an edict changed it to imprisonment awaiting execution.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month the Grand Council submitted its verdict: Yougong's offense warranted decapitation, but an edict commuted it to imprisonment awaiting execution.

sentences.zh: 八月，命原之。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, he was ordered pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month he was pardoned.

sentences.zh: 授福建巡撫。

translations.literal: He was appointed Fujian provincial governor.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed governor of Fujian.

sentences.zh: 三十二年，卒。

translations.literal: In the thirty-second year, he died.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-second year he died.

sentences.zh: 仍免追繳學政任內應罰銀。

translations.literal: Recovery of the fine silver owed from his term as educational commissioner was still waived.
translations.idiomatic: The fine owed from his term as educational commissioner was again waived.

sentences.zh: =李侍堯=李侍堯，字欽齋，漢軍鑲黃旗人，二等伯李永芳四世孫也。

translations.literal: Li Shiyao, style name Qinzhai, was a Han Military Bannerman of the Bordered Yellow Banner, and a fourth-generation descendant of second-class marquis Li Yongfang.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shiyao, whose style was Qinzhai, was a Han bannerman of the Bordered Yellow Banner and a fourth-generation descendant of the second-class marquis Li Yongfang.

sentences.zh: 父元亮，官戶部尚書，諡勤恪。

translations.literal: His father Yuanliang served as minister of Revenue, posthumous name Qinke.
translations.idiomatic: His father Yuanliang had served as minister of Revenue and was posthumously titled Qinke, "Diligent and Respectful."

sentences.zh: 侍堯，乾隆初以廕生授印務章京，見知高宗。

translations.literal: Shiyao, in the early Qianlong reign through yinsheng appointment received the post of seal-affairs clerk, and came to the notice of Emperor Gaozong.
translations.idiomatic: Shiyao entered service in early Qianlong through hereditary privilege as a seal-affairs clerk and won the favor of the emperor.

sentences.zh: 累遷至正藍旗漢軍副都統。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to vice commander-in-chief of the Han Military Plain Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through successive promotions to vice commander of the Han Plain Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 十七年，調熱河副都統。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, he was transferred to vice commander-in-chief at Rehe.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year he was transferred to vice commander at Rehe.

sentences.zh: 二十年，擢工部侍郎，調戶部。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year, he was promoted to vice minister of Works and transferred to Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year he was promoted to vice minister of Works and then transferred to Revenue.

sentences.zh: 署廣州將軍。

translations.literal: He served as acting general of Guangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was named acting general of Guangzhou.

sentences.zh: 劾前將軍錫特庫廢弛馬政，錫特庫下吏議。

translations.literal: He impeached the former general Xiteku for laxness in horse administration; Xiteku was handed to officials for deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: He impeached former general Xiteku for neglect of the horse administration, and Xiteku was referred to the courts for judgment.

sentences.zh: 奏定廣州滿洲、漢軍駐防官制兵額。

translations.literal: He memorialized to fix the official system and troop quotas for the Manchu and Han Military garrisons at Guangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized to establish the official ranks and troop quotas for the Manchu and Han garrisons at Guangzhou.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，署兩廣總督。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year, he served as acting governor-general of the Two Guangs.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year he served as acting governor-general of the Two Guangs.

sentences.zh: 奏：「廣東各屬買補倉穀，兼雜上、中、下三等，而報以上價。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "In the various jurisdictions of Guangdong, when purchasing grain to replenish granaries, upper, middle, and lower grades are mixed together, yet reported at upper-grade prices.
translations.idiomatic: He reported: "Throughout Guangdong, when counties buy grain to replenish granaries, they mix upper, middle, and lower grades but report the purchase at upper-grade prices.

sentences.zh: 應碾米，用上穀；

translations.literal: For rice requiring milling, upper-grade grain should be used;
translations.idiomatic: Grain destined for milling should be upper grade;

sentences.zh: 應藉糶，用中、下穀。

translations.literal: For grain requiring sale by official release, middle and lower grades should be used.
translations.idiomatic: grain for official release should be middle or lower grade.

sentences.zh: 」上諭以所言洞悉情弊，諭各省督撫嚴飭州縣買補當碾試，務得上穀。

translations.literal: " The emperor edicted that his words showed thorough understanding of the abuses, and ordered governors-general and provincial governors of all provinces strictly to instruct prefectures and counties that when purchasing replenishment grain, trial milling must be performed, ensuring upper-grade grain.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor praised his grasp of the abuses and ordered every governor to instruct counties that replenishment purchases must be trial-milled to ensure upper-grade grain.

sentences.zh: 又請禁廣東制錢攙和古錢，並吳三桂偽號錢事。

translations.literal: He also requested prohibiting in Guangdong the mixing of newly minted coin with old coin, and also coins bearing the false reign title of Wu Sangui.
translations.idiomatic: He also asked to ban in Guangdong the debasement of current coin with old currency and coins bearing Wu Sangui's rebel reign title.

sentences.zh: 上諭以「前代錢仍聽行用。

translations.literal: The emperor issued an edict stating that "coin of previous dynasties should still be allowed to circulate.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ruled that currency from earlier dynasties could continue in circulation.

sentences.zh: 吳三桂利用偽號錢，令民間檢出，官為收換，供鼓鑄之用」。

translations.literal: Wu Sangui's coins bearing false reign titles may be used: the people are to search them out, the government will collect and exchange them, for use in reminting."
translations.idiomatic: Wu Sangui's rebel coins were to be gathered from the public, redeemed by the state, and melted down for recoinage."

sentences.zh: 又奏廣州駐防出旗漢軍官兵曠米，平糶便民，上從之。

translations.literal: He also memorialized that the Han Banner officers and soldiers garrisoned at Guangzhou had surplus grain, and proposed selling it at fair prices to benefit the people; the emperor consented.
translations.idiomatic: He also proposed selling surplus grain held by the Guangzhou Han Banner garrison at fair prices to relieve the populace, and the emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，守備張彬佐禁村民演劇被毆，奏請飭讞。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year, Garrison Commandant Zhang Binzuo, while forbidding villagers from staging operas, was assaulted; he memorialized requesting imperial orders for investigation and adjudication.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 23, Garrison Commandant Zhang Binzuo was beaten after trying to stop villagers from putting on plays; Shiyao memorialized asking that the case be thoroughly investigated.

sentences.zh: 上謂：「未得懲創惡習之意。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "This does not capture the intent of punishing and breaking evil customs.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor replied: "That misses the point of curbing a vicious local habit.

sentences.zh: 應先治刁民，後議劣弁，庶刁悍之徒知畏懼。

translations.literal: One should first punish troublesome commoners and only afterward take up the inferior petty officer, so that the obstinate and violent among the people may know fear.
translations.idiomatic: Deal with the unruly villagers first and the incompetent officer second—only then will the lawless learn to tremble.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，實授總督。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year, he was formally appointed Governor-General.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 24 he received formal appointment as Governor-General.

sentences.zh: 奏：「廣東各國商舶所集，請飭銷貨後依期回國，不得住冬；

translations.literal: He memorialized: "Guangdong is where merchant ships of all nations gather; I request orders that after disposing of their goods they return home on schedule and not overwinter;
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized that foreign merchant vessels congregated at Guangdong and asked that they be required to sell their cargoes and sail home on schedule, without overwintering;

sentences.zh: 商館毋許私行交易；

translations.literal: merchant lodges must not engage in private trading;
translations.idiomatic: private trading at the foreign factories must be forbidden;

sentences.zh: 毋許貸與內地行商貲本；

translations.literal: they must not lend capital to inland traveling merchants;
translations.idiomatic: lending capital to inland merchants must be prohibited;

sentences.zh: 毋許僱內地廝役。

translations.literal: they must not hire servants from the interior."
translations.idiomatic: nor may they employ laborers from the interior."

sentences.zh: 」二十五年，又奏：「粵海關各國商舶出入，例於正稅船鈔外有各種規禮，應請刪除名色，並為歸公銀若干。

translations.literal: " In the twenty-fifth year he again memorialized: "When foreign merchant vessels enter and leave Yuehai Customs, besides regular duties and vessel fees there are various customary gratuities; these categories should be abolished and consolidated into a fixed sum payable to the public treasury.
translations.idiomatic: " In Qianlong 25 he proposed reforming Yuehai Customs, abolishing miscellaneous fees levied on foreign vessels beyond standard duties and consolidating them into a fixed public revenue payment.

sentences.zh: 各口僕役飯食、舟車諸費，於此覈銷。

translations.literal: Servants' board, transport costs at the various ports, and other such expenses should be covered from this sum upon audit.
translations.idiomatic: Port laborers' meals, travel costs, and related expenses would be charged against that consolidated fund.

sentences.zh: 」並下部議行。

translations.literal: " He also referred the proposal to the ministries for deliberation and implementation.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was referred to the ministries for approval and implementation.

sentences.zh: 廣西巡撫鄂寶以貴縣僮民韋志剛不法，知縣石崇光察報，避重就輕，請奪官。

translations.literal: Guangxi Governor E Bao, because the Zhuang tribesman Wei Zhigang of Gui County had acted unlawfully and Magistrate Shi Chongguang's investigative report had evaded the grave and treated the light, requested that Chongguang be dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Guangxi Governor E Bao sought to dismiss Magistrate Shi Chongguang for soft-pedaling his report on the Zhuang outlaw Wei Zhigang of Gui County.

sentences.zh: 上以事由崇光察報，命毋奪官；

translations.literal: The emperor held that the matter arose from Chongguang's investigative report and ordered that his office not be taken away;
translations.idiomatic: The emperor held that the case stemmed from Chongguang's report and refused to dismiss him;

sentences.zh: 侍堯奏先經面諭崇光體勘，始行察報，上令逮崇光按鞫。

translations.literal: Shiyao memorialized that he had first personally instructed Chongguang to investigate on the spot before filing his report; the emperor ordered Chongguang arrested and interrogated.
translations.idiomatic: Shiyao explained that he had personally directed Chongguang's on-site investigation before the report was filed; the emperor ordered Chongguang taken into custody for examination.

sentences.zh: 又奏志剛實無不法事，崇光猜疑妄報，仍奪崇光官。

translations.literal: He further memorialized that Zhigang had in fact done nothing unlawful and that Chongguang had reported out of groundless suspicion; Chongguang's office was nevertheless taken away.
translations.idiomatic: He then reported that Zhigang was innocent and that Chongguang had filed a reckless charge born of suspicion—and again insisted on Chongguang's dismissal.

sentences.zh: 上以侍堯與鄂寶各懷意見，飭以「秉虛公，除習氣」。

translations.literal: The emperor, seeing that Shiyao and E Bao each nursed their own views, admonished them: "Maintain impartiality and abandon factional habits."
translations.idiomatic: Finding that Shiyao and E Bao were at cross purposes, the emperor ordered them to "set aside personal bias and shed bad habits."

sentences.zh: 二十六年，召授戶部尚書、正紅旗漢軍都統，襲勳舊佐領。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year he was summoned and appointed Minister of Revenue and Commandant of the Han Military Plain Red Banner, inheriting the hereditary adjutant position of a former meritorious service.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 26 he was recalled to serve as Minister of Revenue and Han Military commandant of the Plain Red Banner, succeeding to a hereditary adjutant post tied to an earlier award of merit.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，授湖廣總督。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year he was appointed Governor-General of Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 28 he was made Governor-General of Huguang.

sentences.zh: 奏：「湖廣行銷淮鹽，抬價病民，請酌中定價。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "In Huguang the sale of Huai salt has raised prices to the people's hurt; I request that a moderate fixed price be determined.
translations.idiomatic: He reported that Huai salt sold in Huguang was priced so high as to burden the populace and asked that a fair standard price be set.

sentences.zh: 」命兩淮鹽政高恆赴湖廣會議，奏請按淮商成本，酌加餘息，明定限制，從之。

translations.literal: " The emperor ordered Lianghuai Salt Controller Gao Heng to go to Huguang for consultation; a memorial requested fixing limits based on Huai merchants' costs with a modest markup, and this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Heng was sent to Huguang to negotiate; the resulting memorial proposed capping prices based on Huai merchants' costs plus a reasonable margin, and the emperor assented.

sentences.zh: 加太子太保。

translations.literal: He was given the additional title Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，調兩廣總督。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year he was transferred to Governor-General of Liangguang.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 29 he was transferred to the Liangguang post.

sentences.zh: 右江鎮總兵李星垣坐婪賄得罪，命侍堯按鞫，擬絞。

translations.literal: Youjiang garrison commander Li Xingyuan was found guilty of taking bribes; Shiyao was ordered to investigate and proposed death by strangulation.
translations.idiomatic: Li Xingyuan, garrison commander at Youjiang, was convicted of graft; Shiyao was ordered to investigate and recommended strangulation.

sentences.zh: 上以侍堯嘗薦星垣，今擬罪輕縱，責侍堯回護，坐降調。

translations.literal: The emperor held that Shiyao had once recommended Xingyuan and was now proposing too lenient a sentence to shield him, and punished Shiyao by demotion and transfer.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor charged that Shiyao, having once recommended Li, was now covering for him with a lenient sentence, and demoted him.

sentences.zh: 以憂還京師。

translations.literal: He returned to the capital on account of mourning.
translations.idiomatic: He went back to Beijing to observe mourning.

sentences.zh: 署工部尚書。

translations.literal: He served as acting Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed acting Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，調署刑部。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year he was transferred to serve as acting head of the Ministry of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 31 he was shifted to acting head of the Ministry of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 三十二年，回兩廣總督任。

translations.literal: In the thirty-second year he returned to his post as Governor-General of Liangguang.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 32 he resumed the Liangguang governorship.

sentences.zh: 襲二等昭信伯。

translations.literal: He succeeded to the hereditary rank of second-class Earl of Zhaoxin.
translations.idiomatic: He inherited the hereditary title of second-class Earl Zhaoxin.

sentences.zh: 三十四年，師徵緬甸，命侍堯傳檄暹羅。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fourth year, when the army marched against Burma, Shiyao was ordered to send a proclamation to Siam.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 34, during the Burma campaign, he was instructed to dispatch a proclamation to Siam.

sentences.zh: 時暹羅方為甘恩敕所據，侍堯以為不宜傳檄；

translations.literal: At that time Siam was held by Gan Enchi; Shiyao thought it inappropriate to issue a formal proclamation;
translations.idiomatic: Siam was then in the hands of Gan Enchi; Shiyao judged that a formal proclamation would be ill-advised;

sentences.zh: 以己意宣諭暹羅各夷目，密偵緬甸，苟入境，令擒以獻，上韙之。

translations.literal: On his own authority he addressed the various chieftains of Siam, secretly to spy on Burma; should Burmese enter, they were to be seized and delivered; the emperor approved.
translations.idiomatic: On his own initiative he instructed Siam's local chiefs to keep watch on Burma and seize any Burmese who crossed the border; the emperor praised his judgment.

sentences.zh: 豐順民硃阿姜謀為亂，督吏捕治。

translations.literal: Zhu Ajiang, a commoner of Fengshun, plotted rebellion; the governor's officers arrested and punished him.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhu Ajiang of Fengshun plotted revolt, provincial officers seized and punished him.

sentences.zh: 三十八年，授武英殿大學士，仍留總督任。

translations.literal: In the thirty-eighth year he was appointed Grand Secretary of the Hall of Martial Glory, while retaining his governorship.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 38 he was made a Grand Secretary of the Wuying Hall but kept his provincial post.

sentences.zh: 安南內亂，令廣西鎮、道嚴防。

translations.literal: When Annam fell into civil war, he ordered the garrison commanders and circuit officials of Guangxi to strengthen their defenses.
translations.idiomatic: During Annam's civil war he ordered Guangxi's military and civil authorities to tighten border security.

sentences.zh: 入覲，賜黑狐端罩。

translations.literal: On presenting himself at court he was granted a ceremonial surcoat trimmed with black fox fur.
translations.idiomatic: At audience he received the honor of a black-fox surcoat.

sentences.zh: 四十年，兵部以廣東民糾黨結盟，不數月至五起，當追論武職弛縱罪。

translations.literal: In the fortieth year the Ministry of War held that because Guangdong commoners had formed factions and sworn brotherhoods, reaching five cases within a few months, military officials' negligence should be investigated.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 40 the Ministry of War called for punishing Guangdong's military officers after five factional outbreaks in as many months.

sentences.zh: 侍堯奏言：「武職既協緝，复追論弛縱罪，則規免處分，必致暗為消弭，兇徒轉得漏網，請寬之。

translations.literal: Shiyao memorialized: "If military officers who have already assisted in arrests are then pursued for prior negligence, they will seek to evade punishment and quietly hush matters up, letting criminals slip through; I ask that this be waived.
translations.idiomatic: Shiyao argued that punishing officers who were actively helping to crack down would only encourage them to hush cases and let ringleaders escape, and he asked for leniency.

sentences.zh: 」上從其請，並諭曰：「侍堯此奏，意在挽回積習。

translations.literal: " The emperor granted his request and further edicted: "This memorial of Shiyao's aims to reverse a deep-seated habit.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor agreed and observed that Shiyao's memorial sought to uproot a longstanding practice.

sentences.zh: 然亦惟侍堯向不姑息屬僚，朕所深信，始可為此言。

translations.literal: Yet it is only because Shiyao has never indulged his subordinates—a fact in which We deeply confide—that he may speak in this way.
translations.idiomatic: Only because Shiyao has never coddled his staff—a quality I trust completely—can he say such a thing.

sentences.zh: 若他人，未可輕為仿效也。

translations.literal: Others must not lightly imitate this."
translations.idiomatic: Others should not imitate it lightly."

sentences.zh: 四十二年，雲貴總督圖思德奏緬甸投誠，籥請納貢。

translations.literal: In the forty-second year Yunnan-Guizhou Governor-General Tu Side memorialized that Burma had submitted in good faith and requested permission to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 42 Governor-General Tu Side reported Burma's submission and its request to resume tribute.

sentences.zh: 上命大學士阿桂往蒞其事，並調侍堯雲貴總督。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Grand Secretary Agui to oversee the matter and transferred Shiyao to Governor-General of Yunnan-Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sent Grand Secretary Agui to supervise and transferred Shiyao to Yunnan-Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 緬甸頭人孟幹謁侍堯，請緩貢。

translations.literal: The Burmese chief Meng Gan called on Shiyao and asked that tribute be deferred.
translations.idiomatic: The Burmese leader Meng Gan petitioned Shiyao to delay the tribute mission.

sentences.zh: 侍堯偕阿桂奏：「孟幹等語反覆，遵旨斷接濟，絕偵探，示以威德，不予遷就。

translations.literal: Shiyao and Agui jointly memorialized: "Meng Gan and others speak equivocally; following the imperial command, supplies should be cut off, espionage ended, and authority and benevolence shown without concession."
translations.idiomatic: Shiyao and Agui reported Meng Gan's evasions and recommended strict compliance with imperial orders: cut off aid, block intelligence, display firmness without yielding.

sentences.zh: 」上召阿桂還。

translations.literal: " The emperor recalled Agui.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor then recalled Agui to court.

sentences.zh: 緬甸歸所留守備蘇爾相，侍堯遣詣京師。

translations.literal: Burma returned the detained garrison commander Su Erxiang, whom Shiyao sent on to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: When Burma released the detained garrison commander Su Erxiang, Shiyao sent him to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 緬甸乞遣孟幹等還，侍堯諭令歸所留按察使銜楊重英，上嘉其合機宜。

translations.literal: Burma asked that Meng Gan and others be sent back; Shiyao ordered the return of the detained Vice Censor-in-Chief Yang Chongying; the emperor praised this as well-timed.
translations.idiomatic: When Burma requested Meng Gan's repatriation, Shiyao ordered Yang Chongying, detained with vice censor rank, sent home as well—an exchange the emperor applauded as shrewd.

sentences.zh: 四十三年，奏獲緬甸遣騰越州民入關為諜，送京師。

translations.literal: In the forty-third year he memorialized that spies sent by Burma from among Tengyue residents had been seized at the border and sent to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 43 he reported the capture of Burmese spies from Tengyue and their dispatch to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 尋奏：「永昌、普洱界連緬甸，擬每歲派兵五千五百，在張鳳街、三台山、九龍口諸地防守。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he memorialized: "Yongchang and Pu'er border Burma; I propose dispatching 5,500 troops each year to garrison Zhangfeng Street, Mount Santai, Jiulong Pass, and other points."
translations.idiomatic: He then proposed garrisoning the Burma-facing border at Yongchang and Pu'er with 5,500 troops annually, posted at Zhangfeng Street, Mount Santai, Jiulong Pass, and similar stations.

sentences.zh: 」上諭以「揆度邊情，不值如此辦理」。

translations.literal: " The emperor edicted: "Judging the border situation, this does not call for such measures."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor replied that the border did not warrant such a deployment.

sentences.zh: 侍堯復請於杉木隴設大汛，撥騰越兵五百；

translations.literal: Shiyao then requested establishing a major post at Shanmulong with 500 troops from Tengyue;
translations.idiomatic: Shiyao scaled back, proposing a major post at Shanmulong with five hundred Tengyue troops;

sentences.zh: 千崖設小汛，撥南甸兵二百，輪駐巡防；

translations.literal: a minor post at Qianya with 200 troops from Nandian on rotating patrol;
translations.idiomatic: a smaller post at Qianya with two hundred Nandian troops on rotation;

sentences.zh: 並分守虎踞、銅壁等關。

translations.literal: and separate garrisons at Huju Pass, Tongbi Pass, and other passes.
translations.idiomatic: and detachments to hold Huju, Tongbi, and other passes.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 四十五年，雲南糧儲道海寧訴侍堯貪縱營私狀，命尚書和珅、侍郎喀寧阿按治。

translations.literal: In the forty-fifth year Yunnan Grain Storage Circuit Intendant Hai Ning accused Shiyao of corruption and private dealing; Ministers Heshen and Vice Minister Kening'a were ordered to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 45 Circuit Intendant Hai Ning denounced Shiyao for graft; Heshen and Kening'a were sent to conduct the inquiry.

sentences.zh: 侍堯自承得道府以下餽賂，不諱，上震怒，諭曰：「侍堯身為大學士，歷任總督，負恩婪索，朕夢想所不到！

translations.literal: Shiyao confessed without concealment to receiving gifts from prefects and magistrates downward; the emperor was enraged and edicted: "Shiyao, a Grand Secretary and former Governor-General, ungratefully extorting—something We never imagined!
translations.idiomatic: Shiyao freely admitted taking bribes from prefectural officials downward. The enraged emperor exclaimed: "A Grand Secretary and former governor-general, ingrate that he is, extorting bribes—I never dreamed of it!

sentences.zh: 」奪官，逮詣京師。

translations.literal: " His office was taken away and he was arrested and brought to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: He was dismissed and brought to Beijing in custody.

sentences.zh: 和珅等奏擬斬監候，奪爵以授其弟奉堯。

translations.literal: Heshen and others proposed death sentence commuted to imprisonment awaiting execution, and stripping his noble title to grant to his younger brother Fengyao.
translations.idiomatic: Heshen's board recommended execution deferred to imprisonment and transfer of the earldom to his brother Fengyao.

sentences.zh: 又下大學士九卿議，改斬決，上心欲寬之，復下各直省督撫議。

translations.literal: The case was referred to the Grand Secretaries and Nine Ministers, who changed the sentence to immediate execution; the emperor wished to show leniency and referred it again to every provincial governor for deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Secretariat and Nine Ministers upgraded the sentence to immediate execution; seeking mercy, the emperor sent the case to every provincial governor for review.

sentences.zh: 各督撫多請照初議定罪，獨江蘇巡撫閔鶚元迎上意，奏：「侍堯歷任封疆，幹力有為。

translations.literal: Most governors favored the original sentence; only Jiangsu Governor Min E'yuan, reading the emperor's mind, memorialized: "Shiyao's long service on the frontiers shows ability and vigor.
translations.idiomatic: Most governors upheld the original verdict; only Jiangsu's Min E'yuan, sensing the emperor's wish, argued that Shiyao's frontier service proved his energy and competence.

sentences.zh: 請用議勤議能之例，寬其一線。

translations.literal: I ask that the precedent for rewarding diligence and ability be applied to spare him by the narrowest margin."
translations.idiomatic: He asked that the precedent for honoring diligence and merit be applied to grant the narrowest reprieve.

sentences.zh: 」上乃下詔，謂：「罪疑惟輕，朕不為已甚。

translations.literal: " The emperor then issued an edict stating: "When guilt is uncertain, prefer leniency; We will not punish excessively.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor proclaimed: "In doubtful cases the lighter penalty applies—I will not be excessive.

sentences.zh: 」改斬監候。

translations.literal: " The sentence was changed to imprisonment awaiting execution.
translations.idiomatic: The sentence was commuted to deferred execution.

sentences.zh: 四十六年，甘肅撒拉爾回蘇四十三為亂，上遣大學士阿桂視師。

translations.literal: In the forty-sixth year the Salar Muslim Su Forty-three raised rebellion in Gansu; the emperor dispatched Grand Secretary Agui to oversee the campaign.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 46 the Salar leader Su Forty-three rebelled in Gansu, and Agui was sent to command.

sentences.zh: 特旨予侍堯三品頂戴、孔雀翎，赴甘肅治軍事。

translations.literal: A special edict granted Shiyao a third-rank hat button and peacock plume, and sent him to Gansu to manage military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: By special order Shiyao received third-rank insignia and a peacock feather and was dispatched to Gansu to handle military affairs.

sentences.zh: 甘肅冒賑事發，總督勒爾謹得罪，命侍堯領總督事，會阿桂按治。

translations.literal: When the Gansu relief-fraud scandal broke, Governor-General Le'erjin was found guilty; Shiyao was ordered to assume the governorship and join Agui in the investigation.
translations.idiomatic: When Gansu's relief fraud came to light and Governor Le'erjin fell, Shiyao took charge of the province and assisted Agui's inquiry.

sentences.zh: 勒爾謹及前布政使王亶望、布政使王廷贊、蘭州知府蔣全迪皆坐斬。

translations.literal: Le'erjin, former Provincial Treasurer Wang Tanwang, Provincial Treasurer Wang Tingzan, and Lanzhou Prefect Jiang Quandi were all sentenced to execution.
translations.idiomatic: Le'erjin, former treasurer Wang Tanwang, treasurer Wang Tingzan, and Lanzhou prefect Jiang Quandi were all executed.

sentences.zh: 上命諸州縣侵冒二萬以上擬斬決，一萬以下斬候，於是皋蘭知縣程棟等二十人皆坐斬。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered that county officials who embezzled 20,000 taels or more be sentenced to immediate execution and those under 10,000 to deferred execution; thus Gaolan Magistrate Cheng Dong and nineteen others were all sentenced to death.
translations.idiomatic: Officials who embezzled twenty thousand taels or more were to be executed outright, those under ten thousand deferred—and twenty county magistrates including Cheng Dong of Gaolan were condemned.

sentences.zh: 四十七年，奏：「皋蘭等三十四廳、州、縣虧庫帑八十八萬有奇、倉糧七十四萬有奇，請於現任總督以下各官養廉扣抵歸補。

translations.literal: In the forty-seventh year he memorialized: "Thirty-four subprefectures, departments, and counties including Gaolan show treasury deficits exceeding 880,000 taels and granary shortfalls exceeding 740,000 shi; I ask that the integrity stipends of the serving Governor-General downward be deducted to make restitution."
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 47 he reported deficits of more than 880,000 taels and 740,000 shi of grain across thirty-four jurisdictions and proposed covering them from officials' integrity stipends down to the governor.

sentences.zh: 」上命寬免。

translations.literal: " The emperor ordered the debt forgiven.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor waived the recovery.

sentences.zh: 又請豁免節年民欠三十萬兩。

translations.literal: He also requested remission of accumulated civilian tax arrears of 300,000 taels.
translations.idiomatic: He also sought remission of three hundred thousand taels in accumulated peasant tax debts.

sentences.zh: 旋命予現任品級頂帶，加太子太保。

translations.literal: He was soon restored to his current rank's hat button and again given the title Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly afterward his rank insignia was restored and he was again made Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 四十九年，廣東鹽商譚達元訴侍堯任兩廣時，總商沈冀州斂派公費餽送，上命尚書福康安按鞫，請罪侍堯。

translations.literal: In the forty-ninth year Guangdong salt merchant Tan Dayuan accused Shiyao that while Governor-General of Liangguang, chief merchant Shen Jizhou had levied public funds for gifts to him; Minister Fukang'an was ordered to investigate and recommend punishment.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 49 salt merchant Tan Dayuan charged that Shiyao had accepted gifts funded by levies the chief merchant Shen Jizhou collected while he governed Liangguang; Fukang'an was ordered to investigate.

sentences.zh: 上責侍堯償繳公費，免其罪。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Shiyao to repay the public funds but exempted him from punishment.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor required restitution of the public funds but dropped the criminal charges.

sentences.zh: 蘇四十三亂既定，上屢諭侍堯密察新教回民。

translations.literal: After Su Forty-three's rebellion was suppressed, the emperor repeatedly ordered Shiyao secretly to watch the New Teaching Muslims.
translations.idiomatic: After Su Forty-three's revolt was crushed, the emperor repeatedly instructed Shiyao to keep close surveillance on New Teaching Muslims.

sentences.zh: 至是，鹽茶廳回田五等復為亂，侍堯會固原提督剛塔捕田五。

translations.literal: At this point the Muslim Tian Wu and others at Yancha Department rebelled again; Shiyao joined Guyuan Regional Commander Gangta in capturing Tian Wu.
translations.idiomatic: Then Tian Wu and fellow Muslims at Yancha Department rebelled again; Shiyao and Regional Commander Gangta of Guyuan moved to capture him.

sentences.zh: 田五自戕，得其孥誅之。

translations.literal: Tian Wu killed himself; his wife and children were seized and executed.
translations.idiomatic: Tian Wu took his own life; his family was captured and put to death.

sentences.zh: 無何，田五之徒復攻靖遠。

translations.literal: Before long, Tian Wu's followers again attacked Jingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Tian Wu's partisans struck Jingyuan again.

sentences.zh: 侍堯駐靖遠，令剛塔督兵往，亂久未定。

translations.literal: Shiyao remained at Jingyuan and ordered Gangta to lead troops against them; the disorder remained unresolved for a long time.
translations.idiomatic: Shiyao held at Jingyuan and sent Gangta against the rebels, but the uprising dragged on.

sentences.zh: 上命大學士阿桂、尚書福康安視師。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Grand Secretary Agui and Minister Fukang'an to take command of the campaign.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sent Agui and Fukang'an to take command.

sentences.zh: 渭城陷，西安副都統明善戰死，賊據石峰堡。

translations.literal: Weicheng fell; Xi'an Deputy Commander Mingshan was killed in battle, and the rebels seized Shifeng Fort.
translations.idiomatic: Weicheng fell, Deputy Commander Mingshan of Xi'an was killed in action, and the rebels held Shifeng Fort.

sentences.zh: 上責侍堯玩延怯懦，奪官，仍在軍效力督餉。
